## Update Dubbing Target Transcript Segments

<a id="opIddubbing_target_transcript_segments_update"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/dubbing/project/string/language/string/transcript/segments \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "segments": {
      "property1": {
        "translation": "string"
      },
      "property2": {
        "translation": "string"
      }
    }
  }'
```

`PATCH /v1/dubbing/project/{project_id}/language/{language_id}/transcript/segments`

Enterprise only. Edit several segments' translations for a language target in one atomic request: every edit applies or none does. Bumps the target's `revision` and marks it `stale` if it had already completed. The source transcript and the project's other languages are untouched, and no audio changes until you regenerate the target.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "segments": {
    "property1": {
      "translation": "string"
    },
    "property2": {
      "translation": "string"
    }
  }
}
```

<h3 id="update-dubbing-target-transcript-segments-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|project_id|path|string|true|Identifier of the dubbing project.|
|language_id|path|string|true|Identifier of the language target.|
|xi-api-key|header|string \| null|false|Your API key. This is required by most endpoints to access our API programmatically. You can view your xi-api-key using the 'Profile' tab on the website.|
|body|body|[DubbingBulkTargetSegmentUpdateRequest](#schemadubbingbulktargetsegmentupdaterequest)|true|none|
|» segments|body|object|true|Map of segment ID to the translation edit to apply to that segment. At least one entry and at most 500.|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|[DubbingTargetSegmentUpdateRequest](#schemadubbingtargetsegmentupdaterequest)|false|A partial edit to a target segment. An omitted field is left unchanged; a provided `null`<br>clears it (see each field for what clearing means).|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "segments": [
    {
      "id": "string",
      "speaker_id": "string",
      "start_s": 0,
      "end_s": 0,
      "source_text": "string",
      "translation": "string"
    }
  ],
  "revision": 0
}
```

> 422 Response

```json
{
  "detail": [
    {
      "loc": [
        "string"
      ],
      "msg": "string",
      "type": "string"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="update-dubbing-target-transcript-segments-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Successful Response|[DubbingBulkTargetSegmentUpdateResponse](#schemadubbingbulktargetsegmentupdateresponse)|
|422|Unprocessable Entity|Validation Error|[HTTPValidationError](#schemahttpvalidationerror)|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## Regenerate Dubbing Target

<a id="opIddubbing_target_transcript_regenerate"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/dubbing/project/string/language/string/transcript/regenerate \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`POST /v1/dubbing/project/{project_id}/language/{language_id}/transcript/regenerate`

Enterprise only. Re-dub a target from its edited transcript, re-synthesizing only the edited regions (charged like a generation, less the free-regeneration allowance). Accepted asynchronously: the target returns to `processing` and sends a `dubbing_language_completed` event to the project's `webhook_ids` when the re-dub lands, carrying the new output URLs. Returns a conflict when the target has no edits to apply — nothing is dispatched and nothing is charged.

<h3 id="regenerate-dubbing-target-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|project_id|path|string|true|Identifier of the dubbing project.|
|language_id|path|string|true|Identifier of the language target.|
|xi-api-key|header|string \| null|false|Your API key. This is required by most endpoints to access our API programmatically. You can view your xi-api-key using the 'Profile' tab on the website.|

> Example responses

> 202 Response

```json
{
  "regenerated_segment_ids": [
    "string"
  ],
  "regenerated_seconds": 0,
  "charged_seconds": 0,
  "free_regeneration_seconds_remaining": 0
}
```

> 422 Response

```json
{
  "detail": [
    {
      "loc": [
        "string"
      ],
      "msg": "string",
      "type": "string"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="regenerate-dubbing-target-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|202|Accepted|Successful Response|[DubbingRegenerateResponse](#schemadubbingregenerateresponse)|
|422|Unprocessable Entity|Validation Error|[HTTPValidationError](#schemahttpvalidationerror)|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## Create Template Run

<a id="opIdcreate_public_template_run"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/flows/templates/string/runs \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "inputs": {
      "prompt": "a corgi on a surfboard",
      "reference": {
        "asset_id": "5xM2KqOnZyce22SPZ9d4",
        "type": "asset"
      }
    },
    "version_id": "latest",
    "webhook": {
      "type": "all"
    }
  }'
```

`POST /v1/flows/templates/{template_id}/runs`

Start a run of a flows template. Pass `version_id` to pin a snapshot, or omit it / pass `latest` to run the latest published version. Set input values under `inputs`, keyed by input port id. The response is the run in its initial state, with every output already listed under its port id in `outputs`. Include `webhook` to receive a `flows_template_run` event carrying the finished run once its `status` is `completed` or `failed`; this is the recommended way to wait. Without one, fetch `GET /v1/flows/templates/{template_id}/runs/{run_id}` at a modest interval until the `status` is terminal.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "inputs": {
    "prompt": "a corgi on a surfboard",
    "reference": {
      "asset_id": "5xM2KqOnZyce22SPZ9d4",
      "type": "asset"
    }
  },
  "version_id": "latest",
  "webhook": {
    "type": "all"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="create-template-run-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|template_id|path|string|true|The ID of the template, as shown in the ElevenLabs app or by `GET /v1/flows/templates`.|
|xi-api-key|header|string \| null|false|Your API key. This is required by most endpoints to access our API programmatically. You can view your xi-api-key using the 'Profile' tab on the website.|
|body|body|[TemplateRunCreateRequest](#schematemplateruncreaterequest)|true|none|
|» inputs|body|object|true|Input values keyed by input port id. Every input port of the version being run must be given; a missing or unknown id is rejected. Pass `{}` for a template with no inputs.|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|[TemplateRunInput](#schematemplateruninput)|false|One value bound to a template input port, in the form its `content_schema`<br>calls for. A `string` port takes the text itself; `number`, `integer` and<br>`boolean` ports take a JSON value of that type. Anything stored elsewhere is<br>a reference discriminated on `type`: a prior `generation`, an uploaded<br>`asset`, a `voice`, or media passed `inline_base64`. An `array` port takes a<br>JSON array with one value per element, admissible for the schema's `items`.<br>`object` ports cannot be bound through this API yet.<br><br>No constraints beyond the wire shape live here: what a port accepts (an<br>`enum`, a length) is stated by its `content_schema`, and the run path<br>validates against that same schema.|
|» version_id|body|string \| null|false|The template snapshot to run. Pass a specific version id to pin that snapshot, or `latest` (the default when omitted) to run the template's most recently published version. Only published versions can be pinned, except by the template's owner, who may also pin an unpublished saved snapshot to try it out before publishing. The live draft is never run through this API.|
|» » *anyOf*|body|string|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» webhook|body|[WebhookTarget](#schemawebhooktarget) \| null|false|Include to send the run's result to the workspace's configured flows webhooks once the run's `status` reaches `completed` or `failed`. One event for the whole run: the `flows_template_run` event's `data` matches the terminal response of `GET /v1/flows/templates/{template_id}/runs/{run_id}`.|
|» » *anyOf*|body|[WebhookTarget](#schemawebhooktarget)|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "id": "sess_JWr5N6X9ZTqf8jD2LmQb",
  "outputs": {
    "marketing_title": {
      "content": "Ride the wave.",
      "id": "Kx2mP7Y4WVrg9kE3NnRc",
      "status": "completed",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "product_demo": {
      "id": "QWr5N6X9ZTqf8jD2La3B",
      "status": "generating",
      "type": "video"
    },
    "product_still": {
      "content_mime_type": "image/png",
      "content_url": "https://storage.googleapis.com/generations/JWr5N6X9ZTqf8jD2LmQb",
      "id": "JWr5N6X9ZTqf8jD2LmQb",
      "status": "completed",
      "type": "image"
    }
  },
  "status": "generating",
  "template_id": "tmpl_abc123",
  "version_id": "ver_01hxyz"
}
```

> 422 Response

```json
{
  "detail": [
    {
      "loc": [
        "string"
      ],
      "msg": "string",
      "type": "string"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="create-template-run-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Successful Response|[TemplateRunResponse](#schematemplaterunresponse)|
|422|Unprocessable Entity|Validation Error|[HTTPValidationError](#schemahttpvalidationerror)|

## List Templates

<a id="opIdlist_public_templates"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/flows/templates \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /v1/flows/templates`

List the published flows templates in your workspace, together with each runnable version's inputs and outputs. Use the ids here as `template_id` / `version_id` on `POST /v1/flows/templates/{template_id}/runs`. Versions built on models that are not available to you through the API are left out, so `versions` is empty when none of a template's published versions is runnable through this API. Templates shared with you by link, or published to Explore from another workspace, are not listed but can still be fetched and run by `template_id`.

<h3 id="list-templates-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|cursor|query|string \| null|false|Pagination cursor: the `next_cursor` value of the previous page's response. Omit it for the first page.|
|page_size|query|integer|false|How many templates to return per page. Lower than the run list's ceiling because each row expands its versions' input and output schemas.|
|versions_per_template|query|integer|false|How many of each template's published versions to return, newest first. `has_more_versions` tells you when a template has more.|
|search|query|string \| null|false|Only return templates whose name or description contains this text.|
|xi-api-key|header|string \| null|false|Your API key. This is required by most endpoints to access our API programmatically. You can view your xi-api-key using the 'Profile' tab on the website.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "has_more": true,
  "next_cursor": "cGFnZXwx",
  "templates": [
    {
      "description": "Drop in a product photo, get a studio shot.",
      "has_more_versions": false,
      "id": "tmpl_abc123",
      "name": "Product shot",
      "versions": [
        {
          "inputs": [
            {
              "content_schema": {
                "title": "Prompt",
                "type": "string"
              },
              "id": "prompt"
            },
            {
              "content_schema": {
                "description": "A clean product photo on any background.",
                "title": "Product photo",
                "type": "image"
              },
              "id": "reference"
            }
          ],
          "is_latest": true,
          "outputs": [
            {
              "content_schema": {
                "title": "Final image",
                "type": "image"
              },
              "id": "product_still"
            }
          ],
          "published_at_unix": 1739721600,
          "version_id": "ver_01hxyz"
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

```json
  "detail": [
    {
      "loc": [
        "string"
      ],

}
```

## Assign Phone Number

<a id="opIdsmb_assign_phone_number"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/smb/phone-numbers/assignments \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "customer_facing_agent_id": "string",
    "area_codes": [
      "string"
    ],
    "number_type": "local"
  }'
```

`POST /v1/smb/phone-numbers/assignments`

Give a receptionist a phone number. A number the workspace already holds but has not attached is used first. Otherwise, in the US and Canada, a number with one of the requested `area_codes` is taken from the pool or bought, falling back to any number in the business's country. In countries that require paperwork, the number is issued right away but takes public calls only once the workspace's own registration is approved (see `accepts_public_calls`). Counts toward the plan's phone number limit, and free plans can take only a few new numbers a day. Returns 404 when no number is available and 403 `telephony_managed_by_reseller` when the reseller supplies the workspace's numbers from its own Twilio account and none is free.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "customer_facing_agent_id": "string",
  "area_codes": [
    "string"
  ],
  "number_type": "local"
}
```

<h3 id="assign-phone-number-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|xi-api-key|header|string \| null|false|Your API key. This is required by most endpoints to access our API programmatically. You can view your xi-api-key using the 'Profile' tab on the website.|
|xi-workspace-id|header|string \| null|false|The customer workspace a reseller's API key acts on.|
|body|body|[CreatePhoneAssignmentRequest](#schemacreatephoneassignmentrequest)|true|none|
|» customer_facing_agent_id|body|string|true|The receptionist that answers calls to the number.|
|» area_codes|body|[string] \| null|false|Preferred US or Canadian area codes, e.g. `["415", "628"]`. Codes outside the business's country are ignored, and any number is given when none of these is available.|
|» » *anyOf*|body|[string]|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» number_type|body|[ApplicationNumberType](#schemaapplicationnumbertype) \| null|false|Local or mobile, in a country that requires paperwork before a number takes calls. Leave unset to try mobile first. Ignored in the US and Canada.|
|» » *anyOf*|body|[ApplicationNumberType](#schemaapplicationnumbertype)|false|Which kind of regulated number a request or an issued number is for.<br><br>Lives here rather than next to the application model because a phone<br>assignment records it too, and the assignment model cannot import from<br>``telephony.models`` without a cycle back into this module.|
|» » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» » *anyOf*|local|
|» » *anyOf*|mobile|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
{
  "phone_number": "string",
  "is_byo": false,
  "provider": "twilio",
  "nanp_area_code": 0,
  "customer_facing_agent_id": "string",
  "deactivated_at_unix": 0,
  "deactivation_reason": "tier_downgrade",
  "regulatory_status": "held",
  "regulatory_number_type": "local",
  "regulatory_country": "string",
  "_id": "string",
  "created_at_unix": 0,
  "updated_at_unix": 0,
  "is_active": true,
  "accepts_public_calls": true
}
```

> 422 Response

```json
{
  "detail": [
    {
      "loc": [
        "string"
      ],
      "msg": "string",
      "type": "string"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="assign-phone-number-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|Successful Response|[SMBPhoneAssignmentDBModel](#schemasmbphoneassignmentdbmodel)|
|422|Unprocessable Entity|Validation Error|[HTTPValidationError](#schemahttpvalidationerror)|

<a id="opIdsmb_reassign_phone_to_agent"></a>

```bash
curl https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/smb/phone-numbers/assignments/string \
```

`PATCH /v1/smb/phone-numbers/assignments/{phone_assignment_id}`

Move a phone number to a different receptionist in the same workspace, which answers its calls from then on. Returns 409 `phone_number_not_attached` for a number no receptionist answers yet (attach it with `POST /v1/smb/phone-numbers/assignments`), and 403 `telephony_managed_by_reseller` when the reseller supplies the workspace's numbers from its own Twilio account.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "customer_facing_agent_id": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="reassign-phone-to-agent-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|phone_assignment_id|path|string|true|none|
|xi-api-key|header|string \| null|false|Your API key. This is required by most endpoints to access our API programmatically. You can view your xi-api-key using the 'Profile' tab on the website.|
|xi-workspace-id|header|string \| null|false|The customer workspace a reseller's API key acts on.|
|body|body|[ReassignPhoneRequest](#schemareassignphonerequest)|true|none|
|» customer_facing_agent_id|body|string|true|The receptionist that answers calls to the number from now on.|

```json
  "nanp_area_code": 0,
  "customer_facing_agent_id": "string",

  "regulatory_number_type": "local",

  "_id": "string",
```

|» » *anyOf*|body|null|false|none|
|» members|body|[[TeamInviteRequest](#schemateaminviterequest)]|false|People to invite once the workspace exists, capped by the tier's team size. Best-effort: each outcome is in `member_results`.|

|parent_branch_id|string \| null|false|none|ID of the parent branch|
|draft_exists|boolean|false|none|Whether a draft exists for the branch|
|draft_created_at|integer \| null|false|none|Unix seconds when the caller's draft on this branch was first created, or null when they have no draft. A draft created before last_committed_at was written against a config the branch has since moved past, so it may not reflect the current one.|
|draft_is_behind_tip|boolean|false|none|Whether the caller's draft on this branch was created before the branch's last commit, meaning it was written against a config the branch has since moved past and may not reflect the current one.|
|calls_7d|integer|false|none|Number of calls in the last 7 days|
|commits_ahead|integer \| null|false|none|Number of commits on this branch not yet on main, relative to their common ancestor. Null if it could not be computed (e.g. no common ancestor, or the branch history exceeds the comparison budget).|
|commits_behind|integer \| null|false|none|Number of commits on main not yet incorporated into this branch, relative to their common ancestor. Null if it could not be computed (e.g. no common ancestor, or the branch history exceeds the comparison budget).|
|merged_into_branch_id|string \| null|false|none|ID of the branch this branch's tip version was merged into, if any|

<h2 id="tocS_AgentKnowledgeBaseRagQueryRequestModel">AgentKnowledgeBaseRagQueryRequestModel</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaagentknowledgebaseragqueryrequestmodel"></a>
<a id="schema_AgentKnowledgeBaseRagQueryRequestModel"></a>
<a id="tocSagentknowledgebaseragqueryrequestmodel"></a>
<a id="tocsagentknowledgebaseragqueryrequestmodel"></a>

```json
{
  "query": "How do I reset my password?",
  "use_agent_defaults": true,
  "max_documents_length": 1,
  "max_retrieved_rag_chunks_count": 1
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|query|string|true|none|Query to run against the agent's knowledge base RAG index.|
|use_agent_defaults|boolean|false|none|When true (the default), retrieval uses the agent's own RAG settings, reproducing exactly what the agent would retrieve. Set to false to retrieve with neutral default RAG settings instead (the agent's embedding model is always kept, since it determines which vector index exists). Useful for auditing the knowledge base independently of how a particular agent is tuned.|
|max_documents_length|integer \| null|false|none|Optional maximum total character length of document chunks returned. Overrides the selected RAG settings for this query only.|
|max_retrieved_rag_chunks_count|integer \| null|false|none|Optional maximum number of document chunks retrieved. Overrides the selected RAG settings for this query only.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|evaluation|[EvaluationSettings-Output](#schemaevaluationsettings-output)|false|none|Settings for evaluation|
|widget|[WidgetConfig-Output](#schemawidgetconfig-output)|false|none|Configuration for the widget|
|data_collection|object|false|none|Data collection settings|
|data_collection_scopes|object|false|none|Scope per data collection item ID. Missing keys default to conversation scope.|
|analysis_items|[AgentAnalysisItems-Output](#schemaagentanalysisitems-output) \| null|false|none|Evaluation + data-collection items attached by reference. None means the agent has not been migrated onto analysis items yet (distinct from an empty, migrated set); reads fall back to the legacy evaluation/data_collection fields in that case.|
|overrides|[ConversationInitiationClientDataConfig-Output](#schemaconversationinitiationclientdataconfig-output)|false|none|Additional overrides for the agent during conversation initiation|
|workspace_overrides|[AgentWorkspaceOverrides-Output](#schemaagentworkspaceoverrides-output)|false|none|Workspace overrides for the agent|
|testing|[AgentTestingSettings](#schemaagenttestingsettings)|false|none|Testing configuration for the agent|
|archived|boolean|false|none|Whether the agent is archived|
|guardrails|[GuardrailsV1-Output](#schemaguardrailsv1-output)|false|none|Guardrails configuration for the agent|
|summary_language|string \| null|false|none|Language for all conversation analysis outputs (summaries, titles, evaluation rationales, data collection rationales). If not set, the language will be inferred from the conversation. Must be one of the supported conversation languages.|
|auto_translate_transcript_to_app_language|boolean \| null|false|none|When enabled, a conversation transcript is automatically translated to the viewer's application language when they open the transcript page. If not set or false, transcripts are shown in their original language unless the viewer manually selects a translation.|
|auth|[AuthSettings](#schemaauthsettings)|false|none|Settings for authentication|
|call_limits|[AgentCallLimits](#schemaagentcalllimits)|false|none|Call limits for the agent|
|queueing_config|[AgentQueueingConfig](#schemaagentqueueingconfig)|false|none|Concurrency wait-queue config for the agent|
|privacy|[PrivacyConfig-Output](#schemaprivacyconfig-output)|false|none|Privacy settings for the agent|
|trust_context|[AgentTrustContext](#schemaagenttrustcontext)|false|none|The trust context in which the agent operates.|
|analysis_llm|[LLM](#schemallm)|false|none|Default LLM model for post-call analysis (evaluation and data collection)|
|topic_discovery|[TopicDiscoverySettings](#schematopicdiscoverysettings)|false|none|Per-agent topic discovery configuration|
|sentiment_analysis|[SentimentAnalysisSettings](#schemasentimentanalysissettings)|false|none|Per-agent post-call sentiment analysis configuration|
|alerting|[AlertingSettingsResponse](#schemaalertingsettingsresponse) \| null|false|none|Agent-level alerting configuration overriding workspace settings.|
|safety|[SafetyResponseModel](#schemasafetyresponsemodel)|false|none|none|

<h2 id="tocS_AgentQueueingConfig">AgentQueueingConfig</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaagentqueueingconfig"></a>
<a id="schema_AgentQueueingConfig"></a>
<a id="tocSagentqueueingconfig"></a>
<a id="tocsagentqueueingconfig"></a>

```json
{
  "enabled": false,
  "wait_timeout_seconds": 180,
  "hold_audio": {
    "audio_path": "string",
    "audio_url": "string",
    "original_filename": "string",
    "duration_secs": 0,
    "size_bytes": 0
  }
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|enabled|boolean|false|none|Hold callers in a wait queue when the agent is at its concurrency limit, instead of rejecting them immediately. New agents are created with queueing enabled unless this field is set explicitly.|
|wait_timeout_seconds|integer|false|none|Maximum time a caller can wait in the queue before being rejected|
|hold_audio|[AgentHoldAudioConfig](#schemaagentholdaudioconfig) \| null|false|read-only|Custom hold audio played to queued callers; when unset, callers hear the default hold tone. Read-only: set it by uploading a file through the agent hold-audio endpoint.|

A single behavioral rule for the agent.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|title|[StrippedStr](#schemastrippedstr)|true|none|Title of the rule.|
|description|[StrippedStr](#schemastrippedstr)|true|none|What the agent should do, in detail.|
|priority|[RulePriority](#schemarulepriority)|false|none|strict: the agent must always follow the rule; suggestion: a guideline.|
|id|string|false|none|none|
|created_at_unix|[UnixTimestamp](#schemaunixtimestamp)|false|none|Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch)|

Identifies an agent as part of the SMB product.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|agent_type|[SMBAgentType](#schemasmbagenttype)|true|none|Distinguishes between the customer-facing voice agent and the internal assistant agent.|
|is_ephemeral|boolean|false|none|True for pre-signup onboarding agents that have not yet been transferred to a user workspace.|
|source_fingerprint|string \| null|false|none|Hash of the SMB data+code inputs this agent was last regenerated against; the conversation-start drift gate. None (unstamped) regenerates once on the next conversation.|

|agent_type|assistant|

<h2 id="tocS_AgentTrustContext">AgentTrustContext</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaagenttrustcontext"></a>
<a id="schema_AgentTrustContext"></a>
<a id="tocSagenttrustcontext"></a>
<a id="tocsagenttrustcontext"></a>

```json
"unknown"
```

The trust context in which the agent operates.

UNKNOWN: not yet classified (existing agents created before this feature).
LOW: serves untrusted external participants (e.g. customer support, sales) —
     outputs should be vetted and tool access scoped.
HIGH: serves the owner (e.g. personal assistant) — full tool access is appropriate.

<h2 id="tocS_AlertingMonitorConfig">AlertingMonitorConfig</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaalertingmonitorconfig"></a>
<a id="schema_AlertingMonitorConfig"></a>
<a id="tocSalertingmonitorconfig"></a>
<a id="tocsalertingmonitorconfig"></a>

```json
{
  "enabled": true,
  "threshold": 0,
  "relative_increase_threshold": 0,
  "min_failure_count": 1,
  "min_history_bucket_count": 1,
  "min_sample_count": 1,
  "suspect_trigger_threshold": 1,
  "auto_resolve_after_inactive_minutes": 1
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|enabled|boolean \| null|false|none|Whether this monitor is enabled and can notify|
|threshold|number \| null|false|none|Failure rate threshold at which this monitor can notify.|
|relative_increase_threshold|number \| null|false|none|Relative increase over the trailing baseline at which this monitor can notify (0.2 = 20% above baseline, 0 = any failure). For conversation_volume_drop it is the share of the usual volume that must be missing, between 0.1 and 0.9 (0.5 = half).|
|min_failure_count|integer \| null|false|none|Minimum failures in the window before this monitor can fire.|
|min_history_bucket_count|integer \| null|false|none|Minimum trailing buckets with traffic before spike detection can fire.|
|min_sample_count|integer \| null|false|none|Minimum samples in the window before this monitor can fire.|
|suspect_trigger_threshold|integer \| null|false|none|How many suspect buckets within the lookback window are required to promote a suspect to an alert.|
|auto_resolve_after_inactive_minutes|integer \| null|false|none|How many minutes an alert can stay inactive before it is auto-resolved.|


Data collection property with optional per-item LLM override for post-call analysis.

TODO: migrate to composition (value_schema: LiteralJsonSchemaProperty + llm) instead of
inheritance, so this generalizes cleanly to object/array schemas in the future.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|type|string|true|none|none|
|description|string|false|none|The description of the property. When set, the LLM will provide the value based on this description. Mutually exclusive with dynamic_variable, is_system_provided, constant_value, and is_omitted.|
|enum|[string] \| null|false|none|List of allowed string values for string type parameters|
|is_system_provided|boolean|false|none|If true, the value will be populated by the system at runtime. Used by API Integration Webhook tools for templating. Mutually exclusive with description, dynamic_variable, constant_value, and is_omitted.|
|dynamic_variable|string|false|none|The name of the dynamic variable to use for this property's value. Mutually exclusive with description, is_system_provided, constant_value, and is_omitted.|
|allowed_values|[AllowedValues](#schemaallowedvalues) \| null|false|none|Server-side rejection guard for an LLM-provided value: the runtime rejects any value outside the permitted set this object names, and the set is not advertised to the LLM as an enum. Only supported when the value source is `description`; combining it with dynamic_variable, is_system_provided, constant_value, or is_omitted is rejected.|
|allowed_values_dynamic_variable|string|false|none|**Deprecated.** DEPRECATED: use `allowed_values` instead. When set, the LLM provides the value but the runtime rejects any value not present in the list held by this dynamic variable (must be a JSON array such as ["ws_alpha", "ws_beta"]). Use to let the LLM pick from a server-verified set (e.g. the IDs the current user is allowed to access). Requires description; mutually exclusive with dynamic_variable, is_system_provided, constant_value, and is_omitted.|
|constant_value|string \| integer \| number \| boolean \| null|false|none|A constant value to use for this property. Mutually exclusive with description, dynamic_variable, is_system_provided, and is_omitted.|
|is_omitted|boolean|false|none|If true, this parameter will be completely omitted from the request. Only valid for optional parameters. Mutually exclusive with description, dynamic_variable, is_system_provided, and constant_value.|
|name|string \| null|false|none|The name of this data collection item.|
|llm|[LLM](#schemallm) \| null|false|none|LLM model to use for this analysis item. If not set, uses agent's analysis_llm default.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|boolean|
|type|string|
|type|integer|
|type|number|

```json
  "api_integration_connection_id": "string",

    "schema_overrides": {
      "property1": {
        "source": "constant",
        "constant_value": "string"
      },
      "property2": {
        "source": "constant",
        "constant_value": "string"
      }
    },
    "response_filter_mode": "all",
    "response_filters": [
      "string"
    ],
    "request_headers": {
      "property1": "string",
      "property2": "string"
    }
  }
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|type|string|false|none|none|
|name|string|true|none|none|
|description|string|true|none|Description of when the tool should be used and what it does.|
|response_timeout_secs|integer|false|none|The maximum time in seconds to wait for the tool call to complete. Must be between 5 and 300 seconds (inclusive).|
|disable_interruptions|boolean|false|none|**Deprecated.** DEPRECATED: use `interruption_mode` instead. If true, the user will not be able to interrupt the agent while this tool is running.|
|interruption_mode|[ToolInterruptionMode](#schematoolinterruptionmode)|false|none|Controls whether the user can interrupt the agent around this tool call. 'allow' (default) lets the user interrupt at any time, 'disable_during_tool' suppresses interruptions only while the tool is running, 'disable_during_tool_and_turn' suppresses interruptions while the tool runs and for the agent response that follows it.|
|force_pre_tool_speech|boolean|false|none|**Deprecated.** DEPRECATED: use `pre_tool_speech` instead. If true, the agent will speak before the tool call.|
|pre_tool_speech|[PreToolSpeechMode](#schemapretoolspeechmode)|false|none|Controls whether the agent speaks before this tool is called. 'auto' (default) decides based on recent tool latency, 'force' always asks the agent to speak, 'off' fully opts out regardless of latency.|
|assignments|[[DynamicVariableAssignment](#schemadynamicvariableassignment)]|false|none|Configuration for extracting values from tool responses and assigning them to dynamic variables|
|tool_call_sound|[ToolCallSoundType](#schematoolcallsoundtype) \| null|false|none|Predefined tool call sound type to play during tool execution. If not specified, no tool call sound will be played.|
|tool_call_sound_behavior|[ToolCallSoundBehavior](#schematoolcallsoundbehavior)|false|none|Determines when the tool call sound should play. 'auto' only plays when there's pre-tool speech, 'always' plays for every tool call.|
|tool_error_handling_mode|[ToolErrorHandlingMode](#schematoolerrorhandlingmode)|false|none|Controls how tool errors are processed before being shared with the agent. 'auto' determines handling based on tool type (summarized for native integrations, hide for others), 'summarized' sends an LLM-generated summary, 'passthrough' sends the raw error, 'hide' does not share the error with the agent.|
|dynamic_variables|[DynamicVariablesConfig](#schemadynamicvariablesconfig)|false|none|Configuration for dynamic variables|
|execution_mode|[ToolExecutionMode](#schematoolexecutionmode)|false|none|Determines when and how the tool executes: 'immediate' executes the tool right away when requested by the LLM, 'post_tool_speech' waits for the agent to finish speaking before executing, 'async' runs the tool in the background without blocking - best for long-running operations.|
|tool_version|string|false|none|The version of the API integration tool|
|api_integration_id|string|true|none|none|
|api_integration_connection_id|string|true|none|none|
|api_schema_overrides|[ApiIntegrationWebhookOverrides](#schemaapiintegrationwebhookoverrides) \| null|false|none|User overrides applied on top of the base api_schema|

|pre_tool_speech|off|

|tool_error_handling_mode|passthrough|
|tool_error_handling_mode|hide|
|execution_mode|immediate|
|execution_mode|post_tool_speech|
|execution_mode|async|

<h2 id="tocS_AuthConnectionStatus">AuthConnectionStatus</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaauthconnectionstatus"></a>
<a id="schema_AuthConnectionStatus"></a>
<a id="tocSauthconnectionstatus"></a>
<a id="tocsauthconnectionstatus"></a>

```json
"active"
```

Single status field shared by every auth type's stored credential.

OAuth values (``REFRESH_FAILED``, ``REVOKED``) are written by the OAuth
token-manager refresh path. ``CREDENTIAL_INVALID`` is written by the
tool execution path when an upstream response matches a credential's
``failure_signatures`` entry (Bearer, Basic auth, etc.).

<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaautogenerationmetadata"></a>

<a id="tocSautogenerationmetadata"></a>
<a id="tocsautogenerationmetadata"></a>

```json
{
  "agent_id": "string",
  "stable_topic_id": "string",
  "criteria_id": "string",
  "topic_label": "string",
  "source_conversation_id": "string",
  "generated_at_unix": 0
}
```

Metadata for an automatically generated simulation test.

Tracks the origin and context of tests that were auto-generated from
conversations, including the source conversation, topic, and evaluation
criteria the test covers.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|agent_id|string|true|none|Agent whose simulation library this test belongs to.|
|stable_topic_id|string|true|none|Stable topic id (from topic discovery) this test covers.|
|criteria_id|string|true|none|Evaluation criterion id this test targets.|
|topic_label|string|true|none|Human-readable topic label at generation time.|
|source_conversation_id|string|true|none|Conversation the test was generated from.|
|generated_at_unix|integer|true|none|Unix timestamp (seconds) when the test was generated.|

<h2 id="tocS_BaseTurnConfig">BaseTurnConfig</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemabaseturnconfig"></a>
<a id="schema_BaseTurnConfig"></a>
<a id="tocSbaseturnconfig"></a>
<a id="tocsbaseturnconfig"></a>

```json
{
  "interruption_ignore_term_languages": [],
  "interruption_ignore_terms": [],
  "merge_with_default_ignore_terms": false,
  "mode": "turn",
  "retranscribe_on_turn_timeout": false,
  "silence_end_call_timeout": -1,
  "speculative_turn": false,
  "spelling_patience": "auto",
  "transcribe_on_disabled_interruptions": false,
  "turn_eagerness": "normal",
  "turn_timeout": 7
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|turn_timeout|number|false|none|Maximum wait time for the user's reply before re-engaging the user|
|initial_wait_time|number \| null|false|none|How long the agent will wait for the user to start the conversation if the first message is empty. If not set, uses the regular turn_timeout.|
|silence_end_call_timeout|number|false|none|Maximum wait time since the user last spoke before terminating the call|
|mode|[TurnMode](#schematurnmode)|false|none|The mode of turn detection|
|turn_eagerness|[TurnEagerness](#schematurneagerness)|false|none|Controls how eager the agent is to respond. Low = less eager (waits longer), Standard = default eagerness, High = more eager (responds sooner)|
|spelling_patience|[SpellingPatience](#schemaspellingpatience)|false|none|Controls if the agent should be more patient when user is spelling numbers and named entities. Auto = model based, Off = never wait extra|
|speculative_turn|boolean|false|none|When enabled, starts generating LLM responses during silence before full turn confidence is reached, reducing perceived latency. May increase LLM costs.|
|retranscribe_on_turn_timeout|boolean|false|none|When enabled, if VAD detects no speech, attempts to re-transcribe accumulated audio at turn timeout. Disables silence discount billing while enabled for the active agent or workflow node.|
|turn_model|[TurnModel](#schematurnmodel)|false|none|Version of the turn detection model to use.|
|interruption_ignore_terms|[string]|false|none|List of terms that should not trigger an interruption when spoken by the user (e.g. 'gotcha', 'understood'). Uses case-insensitive exact matching.|
|interruption_ignore_term_languages|[string]|false|none|Language codes for which preset ignore-term categories have been activated. Stored explicitly so display is not inferred from term overlap.|
|merge_with_default_ignore_terms|boolean|false|none|When enabled, the curated default terms for interruption_ignore_term_languages are used in addition to interruption_ignore_terms.|
|transcribe_on_disabled_interruptions|boolean|false|none|When interruptions are disabled, still transcribe what the user says so it can carry into the next turn. When off, user speech during a non-interruptible turn is ignored and won't trigger a turn.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|mode|silence|
|mode|turn|
|turn_eagerness|patient|
|turn_eagerness|normal|
|turn_eagerness|eager|
|spelling_patience|auto|
|spelling_patience|off|
|turn_model|turn_v2|
|turn_model|turn_v3|

Rule can be either:<br>    an alias rule: {'string_to_replace': 'a', 'type': 'alias', 'alias': 'b', }<br>    or a phoneme rule: {'string_to_replace': 'a', 'type': 'phoneme', 'phoneme': 'b', 'alphabet': 'ipa' }|

<h2 id="tocS_Body_Compose_Music_with_a_detailed_response_v1_music_detailed_post">Body_Compose_Music_with_a_detailed_response_v1_music_detailed_post</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemabody_compose_music_with_a_detailed_response_v1_music_detailed_post"></a>
<a id="schema_Body_Compose_Music_with_a_detailed_response_v1_music_detailed_post"></a>
<a id="tocSbody_compose_music_with_a_detailed_response_v1_music_detailed_post"></a>
<a id="tocsbody_compose_music_with_a_detailed_response_v1_music_detailed_post"></a>

```json
{
  "prompt": "string",
  "generation_mode": "track",
  "music_prompt": {
    "negative_global_styles": [
      "metal",
      "hip-hop",
      "country"
    ],
    "positive_global_styles": [
      "pop",
      "rock",
      "jazz"
    ],
    "sections": [
      {
        "duration_ms": 10000,
        "lines": [
          "Verse 1 lyrics"
        ],
        "negative_local_styles": [
          "metal",
          "hip-hop",
          "country"
        ],
        "positive_local_styles": [
          "pop",
          "rock",
          "jazz"
        ],
        "section_name": "Verse 1"
      }
    ]
  },
  "lyrics_text": "string",
  "composition_plan": {
    "negative_global_styles": [
      "metal",
      "hip-hop",
      "country"
    ],
    "positive_global_styles": [
      "pop",
      "rock",
      "jazz"
    ],
    "sections": [
      {
        "duration_ms": 10000,
        "lines": [
          "Verse 1 lyrics"
        ],
        "negative_local_styles": [
          "metal",
          "hip-hop",
          "country"
        ],
        "positive_local_styles": [
          "pop",
          "rock",
          "jazz"
        ],
        "section_name": "Verse 1"
      }
    ]
  },
  "music_length_ms": 3000,
  "model_id": "music_v1",
  "seed": 0,
  "force_instrumental": false,
  "finetune_id": "string",
  "finetune_strength": 1,
  "use_phonetic_names": false,
  "respect_sections_durations": true,
  "store_for_inpainting": false,
  "with_timestamps": false,
  "with_waveform_visual": false,
  "sign_with_c2pa": false,
  "model_style_prefix": "music"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|prompt|string \| null|false|none|A simple text prompt to generate a song from. Cannot be used in conjunction with `composition_plan`.|
|generation_mode|[MusicGenerationMode](#schemamusicgenerationmode) \| null|false|none|Optional generation mode hint for prompt-based music generation. Can only be used with `prompt`.|
|music_prompt|[MusicPrompt](#schemamusicprompt) \| null|false|none|**Deprecated.** A music prompt. Deprecated. Use `composition_plan` instead.|
|lyrics_text|string \| null|false|none|The lyrics text to use for the generation.|
|composition_plan|[MusicPrompt](#schemamusicprompt) \| [CompositionPlan](#schemacompositionplan) \| null|false|none|A detailed composition plan to guide music generation. Cannot be used in conjunction with `prompt`.|
|music_length_ms|integer \| null|false|none|The length of the song to generate in milliseconds. Used only in conjunction with `prompt`. Must be between 3000ms and 600000ms. Optional - if not provided, the model will choose a length based on the prompt.|
|model_id|[MusicModelID](#schemamusicmodelid)|false|none|The model to use for the generation.|
|seed|integer \| null|false|none|Random seed to initialize the music generation process. Providing the same seed with the same parameters can help achieve more consistent results, but exact reproducibility is not guaranteed and outputs may change across system updates. Cannot be used in conjunction with prompt.|
|force_instrumental|boolean|false|none|If true, guarantees that the generated song will be instrumental. If false, the song may or may not be instrumental depending on the `prompt`. Can only be used with `prompt`.|
|finetune_id|string \| null|false|none|The ID of the finetune to use for the generation|
|finetune_strength|number|false|none|How strongly the finetune influences the generation. Defaults to 1.0 (full strength). Lower values soften the influence of the finetune, leaving more room for prompt-level steering. Only meaningful when `finetune_id` is also provided.|
|use_phonetic_names|boolean|false|none|If true, proper names in the prompt will be phonetically spelled in the lyrics for better pronunciation by the music model. The original names will be restored in word timestamps.|
|respect_sections_durations|boolean|false|none|Controls how strictly section durations in the `composition_plan` are enforced. Only used with `composition_plan` and only applies to `music_v1`; for `music_v2` and `music_v2_5` section durations are always enforced and this is ignored. When false for `music_v1`, the model may adjust individual section durations for better quality and latency, while preserving the total song duration from the plan.|
|store_for_inpainting|boolean|false|none|Whether to store the generated song for inpainting.|
|with_timestamps|boolean|false|none|Whether to return the timestamps of the words in the generated song.|
|with_waveform_visual|boolean|false|none|Whether to return the visual waveform of the generated song.|
|sign_with_c2pa|boolean|false|none|Whether to sign the generated song with C2PA. Applicable only for mp3 files.|
|model_style_prefix|string|false|none|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|model_id|music_v1|
|model_id|music_v2|
|model_id|music_v2_5|
|model_style_prefix|music|
|model_style_prefix|sfx|

```json
{
  "conversation_config": {
    "asr": {
      "keywords": [
        "hello",
        "world"
      ],
      "provider": "scribe_realtime",

      "mode": "turn",

        "message": "Hhmmmm...yeah.",
        "timeout_seconds": -1
      },
      "speculative_turn": false,
      "spelling_patience": "auto",
      "transcribe_on_disabled_interruptions": false,
      "turn_eagerness": "normal",
      "turn_model": "turn_v3",
      "turn_timeout": 7
    },
```

<h2 id="tocS_Body_Create_Dubbing_Language_Target_v1_dubbing_project__project_id__language_post">Body_Create_Dubbing_Language_Target_v1_dubbing_project__project_id__language_post</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemabody_create_dubbing_language_target_v1_dubbing_project__project_id__language_post"></a>
<a id="schema_Body_Create_Dubbing_Language_Target_v1_dubbing_project__project_id__language_post"></a>
<a id="tocSbody_create_dubbing_language_target_v1_dubbing_project__project_id__language_post"></a>
<a id="tocsbody_create_dubbing_language_target_v1_dubbing_project__project_id__language_post"></a>

```json
{
  "target_language": "string",
  "voice_settings": {
    "cloning_strength": 7
  },
  "translations": {
    "property1": "string",
    "property2": "string"
  }
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|target_language|string|true|none|BCP-47 language tag to dub the project into (for example, `fr` or `es-MX`). Must be one of the [languages the project's dubbing model supports](https://elevenlabs.io/docs/help-center/product/dubbing/which-languages-are-supported-in-dubbing), and a region-qualified tag must be one of the supported dialects.|
|voice_settings|[VoiceSettings](#schemavoicesettings) \| null|false|none|Voice settings applied to every speaker in this language. Omit to use the defaults.|
|translations|object \| null|false|none|Enterprise only. Optional translations to use instead of machine translation. A map from each source segment's `external_id` (or its `id`, if you supplied none) to the translated text; every source segment must be covered exactly once. At most 20,000 entries, totaling at most 4 MiB of text. See [Bring your own transcript](https://elevenlabs.io/docs/eleven-api/guides/how-to/dubbing/bring-your-own-transcript).|

<h2 id="tocS_Body_Create_Dubbing_Project_v1_dubbing_project_post">Body_Create_Dubbing_Project_v1_dubbing_project_post</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemabody_create_dubbing_project_v1_dubbing_project_post"></a>
<a id="schema_Body_Create_Dubbing_Project_v1_dubbing_project_post"></a>
<a id="tocSbody_create_dubbing_project_v1_dubbing_project_post"></a>
<a id="tocsbody_create_dubbing_project_v1_dubbing_project_post"></a>

```json
{
  "file": "string",
  "source_url": "string",
  "reference": "string",
  "source_language": "string",
  "model_id": "dubbing_v1",
  "keyterms": [
    "string"
  ],
  "webhook_ids": [
    "string"
  ],
  "target_language": "string",
  "transcript": "string"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|file|string(binary) \| null|false|none|The source media file to dub: an audio or video file of at most 3 GiB. Provide this or `source_url`, not both.|
|source_url|string \| null|false|none|Public HTTP(S) URL the source media is fetched from server-side, subject to the same size and format limits as an upload. Provide this or `file`, not both.|
|reference|string \| null|false|none|Optional free-form string (at most 500 characters) to identify the project on your end. Stored and echoed back verbatim; it does not affect the dub.|
|source_language|string \| null|false|none|BCP-47 language tag of the source media; must be a language the transcription model supports. Any region or script subtag is ignored, since transcription is per-language. Omit to auto-detect.|
|model_id|string \| null|false|none|Dubbing model (`dubbing_v1` or `dubbing_v2`) every language target of this project is dubbed with. Defaults to `dubbing_v2`. Fixed at create time — the source is prepared for this model, so neither the project nor an individual target can change it later.|
|keyterms|[string]|false|none|Key terms to bias transcription and translation toward (for example, product or brand names). At most 1,000 terms; each term at most 50 characters and 5 words; the characters `<>{}[]\` are not allowed. Terms are trimmed and deduplicated. Repeat the field once per term, or pass a single JSON array.|
|webhook_ids|[string]|false|none|IDs of workspace webhooks to notify as this project progresses — the alternative to polling, and what we recommend. Each receives a `dubbing_project_ready` or `dubbing_project_failed` event for the project, and a `dubbing_language_completed` or `dubbing_language_failed` event for every language under it; `dubbing_language_completed` carries the output download URLs. At most 3 IDs, each already configured in your workspace — see [Webhooks](https://elevenlabs.io/docs/eleven-api/resources/webhooks) for how to create one and verify its signature. Repeat the field once per ID, or pass a single JSON array or comma-separated string. Delivery is best-effort and can repeat, so we recommend handling events idempotently.|
|target_language|string \| null|false|none|Optional shortcut: also create a language target in this BCP-47 language, queued to start once the project is ready — equivalent to creating the project and then creating one language target. Must be one of the [languages the dubbing model supports](https://elevenlabs.io/docs/help-center/product/dubbing/which-languages-are-supported-in-dubbing), and a region-qualified tag must be one of the supported dialects. This is the first language target, so it consumes the project's minimum charge rather than adding to it. Its ID is returned in `language_ids`.|
|transcript|string(binary) \| null|false|none|Enterprise only. Optional JSON transcript to use instead of transcribing the source: a `{"segments": [...]}` document, at most 20,000 segments and 4 MiB. See [Bring your own transcript](https://elevenlabs.io/docs/eleven-api/guides/how-to/dubbing/bring-your-own-transcript) for the segment fields and their constraints. `source_language` is required whenever a transcript is provided. If any segment carries a `translation`, `target_language` is required and every segment must carry one; those translations seed the target created via `target_language`, which then skips machine translation.|

<h2 id="tocS_Body_Create_Pronunciation_Dictionaries_v1_studio_projects__project_id__pronunciation_dictionaries_post">Body_Create_Pronunciation_Dictionaries_v1_studio_projects__project_id__pronunciation_dictionaries_post</h2>

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|pronunciation_dictionary_locators|[[PronunciationDictionaryVersionLocatorDBModel](#schemapronunciationdictionaryversionlocatordbmodel)]|true|none|A list of pronunciation dictionary locators (pronunciation_dictionary_id, version_id) encoded as a list of JSON strings for pronunciation dictionaries to be applied to the text. A list of json encoded strings is required as adding projects may occur through formData as opposed to jsonBody. To specify multiple dictionaries use multiple --form lines in your curl, such as --form 'pronunciation_dictionary_locators="{\"pronunciation_dictionary_id\":\"Vmd4Zor6fplcA7WrINey\",\"version_id\":\"hRPaxjlTdR7wFMhV4w0b\"}"' --form 'pronunciation_dictionary_locators="{\"pronunciation_dictionary_id\":\"JzWtcGQMJ6bnlWwyMo7e\",\"version_id\":\"lbmwxiLu4q6txYxgdZqn\"}"'.|
|invalidate_affected_text|boolean|false|none|This will automatically mark text in this project for reconversion when the new dictionary applies or the old one no longer does.|

|quality_preset|[QualityPresetType](#schemaqualitypresettype) \| null|false|none|Output quality of the generated audio. Must be one of:<br>'standard' - standard output format, 128kbps with 44.1kHz sample rate.<br>'high' - high quality output format, 192kbps with 44.1kHz sample rate and major improvements on our side.<br>'ultra' - ultra quality output format, 192kbps with 44.1kHz sample rate and highest improvements on our side.<br>'ultra_lossless' - ultra quality output format, 705.6kbps with 44.1kHz sample rate and highest improvements on our side in a fully lossless format.<br>If not provided, defaults to the highest quality preset available on your subscription tier.<br>|
|title|string \| null|false|none|An optional name of the author of the Studio project, this will be added as metadata to the mp3 file on Studio project or chapter download.|
|author|string \| null|false|none|An optional name of the author of the Studio project, this will be added as metadata to the mp3 file on Studio project or chapter download.|
|description|string \| null|false|none|An optional description of the Studio project.|
|genres|[string]|false|none|An optional list of genres associated with the Studio project.|
|target_audience|string \| null|false|none|An optional target audience of the Studio project.|
|language|string \| null|false|none|An optional language of the Studio project. Two-letter language code (ISO 639-1).|
|content_type|string \| null|false|none|An optional content type of the Studio project.|
|original_publication_date|string \| null|false|none|An optional original publication date of the Studio project, in the format YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY.|
|mature_content|boolean \| null|false|none|An optional specification of whether this Studio project contains mature content.|
|isbn_number|string \| null|false|none|An optional ISBN number of the Studio project you want to create, this will be added as metadata to the mp3 file on Studio project or chapter download.|
|acx_volume_normalization|boolean|false|none|[Deprecated] When the Studio project is downloaded, should the returned audio have postprocessing in order to make it compliant with audiobook normalized volume requirements|
|volume_normalization|boolean|false|none|When the Studio project is downloaded, should the returned audio have postprocessing in order to make it compliant with audiobook normalized volume requirements|
|pronunciation_dictionary_locators|[string]|false|none|A list of pronunciation dictionary locators (pronunciation_dictionary_id, version_id) encoded as a list of JSON strings for pronunciation dictionaries to be applied to the text. A list of json encoded strings is required as adding projects may occur through formData as opposed to jsonBody. To specify multiple dictionaries use multiple --form lines in your curl, such as --form 'pronunciation_dictionary_locators="{\"pronunciation_dictionary_id\":\"Vmd4Zor6fplcA7WrINey\",\"version_id\":\"hRPaxjlTdR7wFMhV4w0b\"}"' --form 'pronunciation_dictionary_locators="{\"pronunciation_dictionary_id\":\"JzWtcGQMJ6bnlWwyMo7e\",\"version_id\":\"lbmwxiLu4q6txYxgdZqn\"}"'.|
|callback_url|string \| null|false|none|<br>    A url that will be called by our service when the Studio project is converted. Request will contain a json blob containing the status of the conversion<br>    Messages:<br>    1. When project was converted successfully:<br>    {<br>      type: "project_conversion_status",<br>      event_timestamp: 1234567890,<br>      data: {<br>        request_id: "1234567890",<br>        project_id: "21m00Tcm4TlvDq8ikWAM",<br>        conversion_status: "success",<br>        project_snapshot_id: "22m00Tcm4TlvDq8ikMAT",<br>        error_details: None,<br>      }<br>    }<br>    2. When project conversion failed:<br>    {<br>      type: "project_conversion_status",<br>      event_timestamp: 1234567890,<br>      data: {<br>        request_id: "1234567890",<br>        project_id: "21m00Tcm4TlvDq8ikWAM",<br>        conversion_status: "error",<br>        project_snapshot_id: None,<br>        error_details: "Error details if conversion failed"<br>      }<br>    }<br><br>    3. When chapter was converted successfully:<br>    {<br>      type: "chapter_conversion_status",<br>      event_timestamp: 1234567890,<br>      data: {<br>        request_id: "1234567890",<br>        project_id: "21m00Tcm4TlvDq8ikWAM",<br>        chapter_id: "22m00Tcm4TlvDq8ikMAT",<br>        conversion_status: "success",<br>        chapter_snapshot_id: "23m00Tcm4TlvDq8ikMAV",<br>        error_details: None,<br>      }<br>    }<br>    4. When chapter conversion failed:<br>    {<br>      type: "chapter_conversion_status",<br>      event_timestamp: 1234567890,<br>      data: {<br>        request_id: "1234567890",<br>        project_id: "21m00Tcm4TlvDq8ikWAM",<br>        chapter_id: "22m00Tcm4TlvDq8ikMAT",<br>        conversion_status: "error",<br>        chapter_snapshot_id: None,<br>        error_details: "Error details if conversion failed"<br>      }<br>    }<br>    |
|fiction|string \| null|false|none|An optional specification of whether the content of this Studio project is fiction.|
|apply_text_normalization|string \| null|false|none|<br>    This parameter controls text normalization with four modes: 'auto', 'on', 'apply_english' and 'off'.<br>    When set to 'auto', the system will automatically decide whether to apply text normalization<br>    (e.g., spelling out numbers). With 'on', text normalization will always be applied, while<br>    with 'off', it will be skipped. 'apply_english' is the same as 'on' but will assume that text is in English.<br>    |
|auto_convert|boolean|false|none|Whether to auto convert the Studio project to audio or not.|
|auto_assign_voices|boolean \| null|false|none|[Alpha Feature] Whether automatically assign voices to phrases in the create Project.|
|source_type|string \| null|false|none|The type of Studio project to create.|
|voice_settings|[string]|false|none|    Optional voice settings overrides for the project, encoded as a list of JSON strings.<br><br>    Example:<br>    ["{\"voice_id\": \"21m00Tcm4TlvDq8ikWAM\", \"stability\": 0.7, \"similarity_boost\": 0.8, \"style\": 0.5, \"speed\": 1.0, \"use_speaker_boost\": true}"]<br>    |
|create_publishing_read|boolean \| null|false|none|If true, creates a corresponding read for direct publishing in draft state|

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

<h2 id="tocS_Body_Create_a_new_branch_v1_convai_agents__agent_id__branches_post">Body_Create_a_new_branch_v1_convai_agents__agent_id__branches_post</h2>

```json
{
  "parent_version_id": "string",
  "name": "string",
  "description": "string",
  "conversation_config": {},
  "platform_settings": {},
  "workflow": {
    "edges": {
      "entry_to_tool_a": {
        "forward_condition": {
          "condition": "Tool A condition"
        },
        "source": "entry_node",
        "target": "tool_node_a"
      },
      "start_to_entry": {
        "forward_condition": {},
        "source": "start_node",
        "target": "entry_node"
      },
      "tool_a_to_failure": {
        "forward_condition": {
          "successful": false
        },
        "source": "tool_node_a",
        "target": "failure_node"
      },
      "tool_a_to_tool_b": {
        "forward_condition": {
          "successful": true
        },
        "source": "tool_node_a",
        "target": "tool_node_b"
      },
      "tool_b_to_agent_transfer": {
        "forward_condition": {},
        "source": "tool_node_b",
        "target": "success_transfer"
      },
      "tool_b_to_conversation": {
        "forward_condition": {
          "condition": "Conversation condition"
        },
        "source": "tool_node_b",
        "target": "success_conversation"
      },
      "tool_b_to_end": {
        "forward_condition": {
          "condition": "End condition"
        },
        "source": "tool_node_b",
        "target": "success_end"
      },
      "tool_b_to_phone": {
        "forward_condition": {
          "expression": {
            "children": [
              {
                "name": "force_phone_transfer"
              },
              {
                "prompt": "Phone condition",
                "value_schema": {
                  "description": "Phone condition",
                  "type": "boolean"
                }
              },
              {
                "left": {
                  "name": "mode"
                },
                "right": {
                  "value": "dev"
                }
              }
            ]
          }
        },
        "source": "tool_node_b",
        "target": "success_phone"
      }
    },
    "nodes": {
      "entry_node": {
        "conversation_config": {},
        "edge_order": [
          "entry_to_tool_a"
        ],
        "label": "Entry"
      },
      "failure_node": {
        "conversation_config": {},
        "label": "Failure"
      },
      "start_node": {
        "edge_order": [
          "start_to_entry"
        ]
      },
      "success_conversation": {
        "conversation_config": {},
        "label": "Success A"
      },
      "success_end": {},
      "success_phone": {
        "transfer_destination": {
          "phone_number": "+1234567890"
        }
      },
      "success_transfer": {
        "agent_id": "success_transfer_agent"
      },
      "tool_node_a": {
        "edge_order": [
          "tool_a_to_failure",
          "tool_a_to_tool_b"
        ],
        "tools": [
          {
            "tool_id": "tool_a"
          },
          {
            "tool_id": "tool_b"
          }
        ]
      },
      "tool_node_b": {
        "edge_order": [
          "tool_b_to_conversation",
          "tool_b_to_end",
          "tool_b_to_phone",
          "tool_b_to_agent_transfer"
        ],
        "tools": [
          {
            "tool_id": "tool_a"
          }
        ]
      }
    }
  },
  "include_draft": false
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|parent_version_id|string|true|none|ID of the version to branch from|
|name|string|true|none|Name of the branch. It is unique within the agent.|
|description|string|true|none|Description for the branch|
|conversation_config|object \| null|false|none|Changes to apply to conversation config|
|platform_settings|object \| null|false|none|Changes to apply to platform settings|
|workflow|[AgentWorkflowRequestModel](#schemaagentworkflowrequestmodel) \| null|false|none|Updated workflow definition|
|include_draft|boolean|false|none|When true, the new branch uses the caller's draft procedure set instead of the branch tip. Requires parent_version_id to be the branch tip.|

```json
      "entry_to_tool_a": {
        "forward_condition": {
          "condition": "Tool A condition"
        },
        "source": "entry_node",
        "target": "tool_node_a"
      },
      "start_to_entry": {
        "forward_condition": {},
        "source": "start_node",
        "target": "entry_node"
      },
      "tool_a_to_failure": {
        "forward_condition": {
          "successful": false
        },
        "source": "tool_node_a",
        "target": "failure_node"
      },
      "tool_a_to_tool_b": {
        "forward_condition": {
          "successful": true
        },
        "source": "tool_node_a",
        "target": "tool_node_b"
      },
      "tool_b_to_agent_transfer": {
        "forward_condition": {},
        "source": "tool_node_b",
        "target": "success_transfer"
      },
      "tool_b_to_conversation": {
        "forward_condition": {
          "condition": "Conversation condition"
        },
        "source": "tool_node_b",
        "target": "success_conversation"
      },
      "tool_b_to_end": {
        "forward_condition": {
          "condition": "End condition"
        },
        "source": "tool_node_b",
        "target": "success_end"
      },
      "tool_b_to_phone": {
        "forward_condition": {
          "expression": {
            "children": [
              {
                "name": "force_phone_transfer"
              },
              {
                "prompt": "Phone condition",
                "value_schema": {
                  "description": "Phone condition",
                  "type": "boolean"
                }
              },
              {
                "left": {
                  "name": "mode"
                },
                "right": {
                  "value": "dev"
                }
              }
            ]
          }
        },
        "source": "tool_node_b",
        "target": "success_phone"
      }
    },
    "nodes": {
      "entry_node": {
        "conversation_config": {},
        "edge_order": [
          "entry_to_tool_a"
        ],
        "label": "Entry"
      },
      "failure_node": {
        "conversation_config": {},
        "label": "Failure"
      },
      "start_node": {
        "edge_order": [
          "start_to_entry"
        ]
      },
      "success_conversation": {
        "conversation_config": {},
        "label": "Success A"
      },
      "success_end": {},
      "success_phone": {
        "transfer_destination": {
          "phone_number": "+1234567890"
        }
      },
      "success_transfer": {
        "agent_id": "success_transfer_agent"
      },
      "tool_node_a": {
        "edge_order": [
          "tool_a_to_failure",
          "tool_a_to_tool_b"
        ],
        "tools": [
          {
            "tool_id": "tool_a"
          },
          {
            "tool_id": "tool_b"
          }
        ]
      },
      "tool_node_b": {
        "edge_order": [
          "tool_b_to_conversation",
          "tool_b_to_end",
          "tool_b_to_phone",
          "tool_b_to_agent_transfer"
        ],
        "tools": [
          {
            "tool_id": "tool_a"
          }
        ]
      }
    }
  },
  "name": "string",
  "tags": [
    "Customer Support",
    "Technical Help",
    "Eleven"
  ]
}
```

|platform_settings|object|true|none|Platform settings for the draft|

<h2 id="tocS_Body_Create_crawl_job_v1_convai_knowledge_base_crawl_post">Body_Create_crawl_job_v1_convai_knowledge_base_crawl_post</h2>

<a id="schema_Body_Create_crawl_job_v1_convai_knowledge_base_crawl_post"></a>
<a id="tocSbody_create_crawl_job_v1_convai_knowledge_base_crawl_post"></a>
<a id="tocsbody_create_crawl_job_v1_convai_knowledge_base_crawl_post"></a>

```json
{
  "url": "string",
  "max_depth": 3,
  "max_pages": 1000,
  "pattern": "string",
  "exclude_patterns": [
    "string"
  ],
  "sitemap_urls": [
    "string"
  ],
  "parent_folder_id": "string",
  "enable_auto_sync": false,
  "auto_remove": false,
  "auto_discover": false,
  "minimum_frequency_days": 1
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|url|string|true|none|URL to a page of documentation that the agent will have access to in order to interact with users.|
|max_depth|integer|false|none|**Deprecated.** Deprecated - this field is a no-op and will be removed in a future version.|
|max_pages|integer|false|none|Maximum number of pages to crawl (1-10,000), defaults to 1000.|
|pattern|string \| null|false|none|If set, only URLs that match this pattern are included.|
|exclude_patterns|[string] \| null|false|none|If set, URLs that match any of these patterns are skipped, even if they match `pattern`.|
|sitemap_urls|[string] \| null|false|none|List of URLs to crawl from sitemap (optional, overrides automatic URL discovery).|
|parent_folder_id|string \| null|false|none|If set, the created document or folder will be placed inside the given folder.|
|enable_auto_sync|boolean|false|none|Whether to enable auto-sync for this URL document.|
|auto_remove|boolean|false|none|Whether to automatically remove the document if the URL becomes unavailable. Only applicable when auto-sync is enabled.|
|auto_discover|boolean|false|none|Automatically discover and add new pages linked from already-crawled pages during auto-sync. Requires enable_auto_sync=true.|
|minimum_frequency_days|integer \| null|false|none|Minimum frequency (in days) at which the underlying eligible documents are refreshed. The actual interval may be shorter, never longer. Defaults to 7, tightened to the parent folder's frequency if that is stricter. Only applicable when auto-sync is enabled.|

```json
{
```

```json
  "highlights": [

  ],

  ],

```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|model_id|string|true|none|The ID of the model to be used for this Studio project, you can query GET /v1/models to list all available models.|
|mode|[PodcastConversationMode](#schemapodcastconversationmode) \| [PodcastBulletinMode](#schemapodcastbulletinmode)|true|none|The type of podcast to generate. Can be 'conversation', an interaction between two voices, or 'bulletin', a monologue.|
|source|[PodcastTextSource](#schemapodcasttextsource) \| [PodcastURLSource](#schemapodcasturlsource) \| [[PodcastTextSource](#schemapodcasttextsource) \| [PodcastURLSource](#schemapodcasturlsource)]|true|none|The source content for the Podcast.|
|quality_preset|[QualityPresetType](#schemaqualitypresettype) \| null|false|none|Output quality of the generated audio. Must be one of:<br>'standard' - standard output format, 128kbps with 44.1kHz sample rate.<br>'high' - high quality output format, 192kbps with 44.1kHz sample rate and major improvements on our side.<br>'ultra' - ultra quality output format, 192kbps with 44.1kHz sample rate and highest improvements on our side.<br>'ultra_lossless' - ultra quality output format, 705.6kbps with 44.1kHz sample rate and highest improvements on our side in a fully lossless format.<br>If not provided, defaults to the highest quality preset available on your subscription tier.<br>|
|duration_scale|string|false|none|Duration of the generated podcast. Must be one of:<br>short - produces podcasts shorter than 3 minutes.<br>default - produces podcasts roughly between 3-7 minutes.<br>long - produces podcasts longer than 7 minutes.<br>|
|language|string \| null|false|none|An optional language of the Studio project. Two-letter language code (ISO 639-1).|
|intro|string \| null|false|none|The intro text that will always be added to the beginning of the podcast.|
|outro|string \| null|false|none|The outro text that will always be added to the end of the podcast.|
|instructions_prompt|string \| null|false|none|Additional instructions prompt for the podcast generation used to adjust the podcast's style and tone.|
|highlights|[string] \| null|false|none|A brief summary or highlights of the Studio project's content, providing key points or themes. This should be between 10 and 70 characters.|
|callback_url|string \| null|false|none|<br>    A url that will be called by our service when the Studio project is converted. Request will contain a json blob containing the status of the conversion<br>    Messages:<br>    1. When project was converted successfully:<br>    {<br>      type: "project_conversion_status",<br>      event_timestamp: 1234567890,<br>      data: {<br>        request_id: "1234567890",<br>        project_id: "21m00Tcm4TlvDq8ikWAM",<br>        conversion_status: "success",<br>        project_snapshot_id: "22m00Tcm4TlvDq8ikMAT",<br>        error_details: None,<br>      }<br>    }<br>    2. When project conversion failed:<br>    {<br>      type: "project_conversion_status",<br>      event_timestamp: 1234567890,<br>      data: {<br>        request_id: "1234567890",<br>        project_id: "21m00Tcm4TlvDq8ikWAM",<br>        conversion_status: "error",<br>        project_snapshot_id: None,<br>        error_details: "Error details if conversion failed"<br>      }<br>    }<br><br>    3. When chapter was converted successfully:<br>    {<br>      type: "chapter_conversion_status",<br>      event_timestamp: 1234567890,<br>      data: {<br>        request_id: "1234567890",<br>        project_id: "21m00Tcm4TlvDq8ikWAM",<br>        chapter_id: "22m00Tcm4TlvDq8ikMAT",<br>        conversion_status: "success",<br>        chapter_snapshot_id: "23m00Tcm4TlvDq8ikMAV",<br>        error_details: None,<br>      }<br>    }<br>    4. When chapter conversion failed:<br>    {<br>      type: "chapter_conversion_status",<br>      event_timestamp: 1234567890,<br>      data: {<br>        request_id: "1234567890",<br>        project_id: "21m00Tcm4TlvDq8ikWAM",<br>        chapter_id: "22m00Tcm4TlvDq8ikMAT",<br>        conversion_status: "error",<br>        chapter_snapshot_id: None,<br>        error_details: "Error details if conversion failed"<br>      }<br>    }<br>    |
|apply_text_normalization|string \| null|false|none|<br>    This parameter controls text normalization with four modes: 'auto', 'on', 'apply_english' and 'off'.<br>    When set to 'auto', the system will automatically decide whether to apply text normalization<br>    (e.g., spelling out numbers). With 'on', text normalization will always be applied, while<br>    with 'off', it will be skipped. 'apply_english' is the same as 'on' but will assume that text is in English.<br>    |

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|duration_scale|short|
|duration_scale|default|
|duration_scale|long|

HTML should be formatted as follows '&lt;html&gt;&lt;body&gt;&lt;div&gt;&lt;p&gt;Your content&lt;/p&gt;&lt;h3&gt;More of your content&lt;/h3&gt;&lt;p&gt;Some more of your content&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/body&gt;&lt;/html&gt;'|
|auto_convert|boolean|false|none|Whether to auto convert the project to audio or not.|
|apply_text_normalization|string \| null|false|none|<br>    This parameter controls text normalization with four modes: 'auto', 'on', 'apply_english' and 'off'.<br>    When set to 'auto', the system will automatically decide whether to apply text normalization<br>    (e.g., spelling out numbers). With 'on', text normalization will always be applied, while<br>    with 'off', it will be skipped. 'apply_english' is the same as 'on' but will assume that text is in English.<br>    |
|pronunciation_dictionary_locators|[string]|false|none|A list of pronunciation dictionary locators (pronunciation_dictionary_id, version_id) encoded as a list of JSON strings for pronunciation dictionaries to be applied to the text. A list of json encoded strings is required as adding projects may occur through formData as opposed to jsonBody. To specify multiple dictionaries use multiple --form lines in your curl, such as --form 'pronunciation_dictionary_locators="{\"pronunciation_dictionary_id\":\"Vmd4Zor6fplcA7WrINey\",\"version_id\":\"hRPaxjlTdR7wFMhV4w0b\"}"' --form 'pronunciation_dictionary_locators="{\"pronunciation_dictionary_id\":\"JzWtcGQMJ6bnlWwyMo7e\",\"version_id\":\"lbmwxiLu4q6txYxgdZqn\"}"'.|
