<h2 id="tocS_Body_Dub_a_video_or_an_audio_file_v1_dubbing_post">Body_Dub_a_video_or_an_audio_file_v1_dubbing_post</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemabody_dub_a_video_or_an_audio_file_v1_dubbing_post"></a>
<a id="schema_Body_Dub_a_video_or_an_audio_file_v1_dubbing_post"></a>
<a id="tocSbody_dub_a_video_or_an_audio_file_v1_dubbing_post"></a>
<a id="tocsbody_dub_a_video_or_an_audio_file_v1_dubbing_post"></a>

```json
{
  "file": "string",
  "csv_file": "string",
  "foreground_audio_file": "string",
  "background_audio_file": "string",
  "name": "string",
  "source_url": "string",
  "source_lang": "auto",
  "target_lang": "string",
  "target_accent": "string",
  "num_speakers": 0,
  "watermark": false,
  "start_time": 0,
  "end_time": 0,
  "highest_resolution": false,
  "drop_background_audio": false,
  "use_profanity_filter": true,
  "dubbing_studio": false,
  "disable_voice_cloning": false,
  "mode": "automatic",
  "csv_fps": 0
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|file|string(binary) \| null|false|none|A list of file paths to audio recordings intended for voice cloning|
|csv_file|string(binary) \| null|false|none|CSV file containing transcription/translation metadata|
|foreground_audio_file|string(binary) \| null|false|none|For use only with csv input|
|background_audio_file|string(binary) \| null|false|none|For use only with csv input|
|name|string \| null|false|none|Name of the dubbing project.|
|source_url|string \| null|false|none|URL of the source video/audio file.|
|source_lang|string|false|none|Source language. Expects a valid iso639-1 or iso639-3 language code.|
|target_lang|string \| null|false|none|The Target language to dub the content into. Expects a valid iso639-1 or iso639-3 language code.|
|target_accent|string \| null|false|none|[Experimental] An accent to apply when selecting voices from the library and to use to inform translation of the dialect to prefer.|
|num_speakers|integer|false|none|Number of speakers to use for the dubbing. Set to 0 to automatically detect the number of speakers|
|watermark|boolean|false|none|Whether to apply watermark to the output video.|
|start_time|integer \| null|false|none|Start time of the source video/audio file.|
|end_time|integer \| null|false|none|End time of the source video/audio file.|
|highest_resolution|boolean|false|none|Whether to use the highest resolution available.|
|drop_background_audio|boolean|false|none|An advanced setting. Whether to drop background audio from the final dub. This can improve dub quality where it's known that audio shouldn't have a background track such as for speeches or monologues.|
|use_profanity_filter|boolean \| null|false|none|[BETA] Whether transcripts should have profanities censored with the words '[censored]'|
|dubbing_studio|boolean|false|none|Whether to prepare dub for edits in dubbing studio or edits as a dubbing resource.|
|disable_voice_cloning|boolean|false|none|Instead of using a voice clone in dubbing, use a similar voice from the ElevenLabs Voice Library. Voices used from the library will contribute towards a workspace's custom voices limit, and if there aren't enough available slots the dub will fail. Using this feature requires the caller to have the 'add_voice_from_voice_library' permission on their workspace to access new voices.|
|mode|string|false|none|The mode in which to run this Dubbing job. Defaults to automatic, use manual if specifically providing a CSV transcript to use. Note that manual mode is experimental and production use is strongly discouraged.|
|csv_fps|number \| null|false|none|Frames per second to use when parsing a CSV file for dubbing. If not provided, FPS will be inferred from timecodes.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|mode|automatic|
|mode|manual|

<h2 id="tocS_Body_Get_Workspace_Usage_v1_workspace_analytics_query_usage_by_product_over_time_post">Body_Get_Workspace_Usage_v1_workspace_analytics_query_usage_by_product_over_time_post</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemabody_get_workspace_usage_v1_workspace_analytics_query_usage_by_product_over_time_post"></a>
<a id="schema_Body_Get_Workspace_Usage_v1_workspace_analytics_query_usage_by_product_over_time_post"></a>
<a id="tocSbody_get_workspace_usage_v1_workspace_analytics_query_usage_by_product_over_time_post"></a>
<a id="tocsbody_get_workspace_usage_v1_workspace_analytics_query_usage_by_product_over_time_post"></a>

```json
{
  "start_time": 1577836800000,
  "end_time": 1577836800000,
  "interval_seconds": 60,
  "group_by": [
    "product_type"
  ],
  "filters": [
    {
      "column": "string",
      "operation": "in",
      "values": [
        "string"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "time_zone": "UTC"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|start_time|integer|true|none|Start of the time range as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds. Must be at least 2020-01-01.|
|end_time|integer|true|none|End of the time range as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds. Must be at least 2020-01-01.|
|interval_seconds|integer|false|none|Bucket size in seconds. Each row in the response covers this many seconds of the selected time range. For example, pass 3600 for hourly buckets, 86400 for daily buckets, or 604800 for weekly buckets. Whether `time_zone` shifts bucket boundaries depends on this value: week multiples (e.g. 604800) are calendar weeks that start Monday at local midnight; whole-day multiples that are not whole weeks (e.g. 86400) align to local midnight; whole-hour multiples up to 24 hours (e.g. 3600, 14400) align to local hour boundaries from midnight; sub-hour values and other sizes remain UTC-anchored regardless of `time_zone`.|
|group_by|[string] \| null|false|none|none|
|filters|[[ColumnFilter](#schemacolumnfilter)] \| null|false|none|none|
|time_zone|string|false|none|IANA time zone identifier (e.g. 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London', 'UTC') used to align bucket boundaries for eligible `interval_seconds` values. Week multiples (e.g. 604800) are calendar weeks that start Monday at local midnight. Whole-day multiples that are not whole weeks start at local midnight; whole-hour multiples up to 24 hours align to local hour boundaries from midnight. Sub-hour intervals and other bucket sizes remain UTC-anchored regardless of this setting. Defaults to UTC.|

```json
{
  "conversation_config": {},
  "platform_settings": {},
  "workflow": {
    "edges": {
      "entry_to_tool_a": {
        "forward_condition": {
          "condition": "Tool A condition"
        },
        "source": "entry_node",
        "target": "tool_node_a"
      },
      "start_to_entry": {
        "forward_condition": {},
        "source": "start_node",
        "target": "entry_node"
      },
      "tool_a_to_failure": {
        "forward_condition": {
          "successful": false
        },
        "source": "tool_node_a",
        "target": "failure_node"
      },
      "tool_a_to_tool_b": {
        "forward_condition": {
          "successful": true
        },
        "source": "tool_node_a",
        "target": "tool_node_b"
      },
      "tool_b_to_agent_transfer": {
        "forward_condition": {},
        "source": "tool_node_b",
        "target": "success_transfer"
      },
      "tool_b_to_conversation": {
        "forward_condition": {
          "condition": "Conversation condition"
        },
        "source": "tool_node_b",
        "target": "success_conversation"
      },
      "tool_b_to_end": {
        "forward_condition": {
          "condition": "End condition"
        },
        "source": "tool_node_b",
        "target": "success_end"
      },
      "tool_b_to_phone": {
        "forward_condition": {
          "expression": {
            "children": [
              {
                "name": "force_phone_transfer"
              },
              {
                "prompt": "Phone condition",
                "value_schema": {
                  "description": "Phone condition",
                  "type": "boolean"
                }
              },
              {
                "left": {
                  "name": "mode"
                },
                "right": {
                  "value": "dev"
                }
              }
            ]
          }
        },
        "source": "tool_node_b",
        "target": "success_phone"
      }
    },
    "nodes": {
      "entry_node": {
        "conversation_config": {},
        "edge_order": [
          "entry_to_tool_a"
        ],
        "label": "Entry"
      },
      "failure_node": {
        "conversation_config": {},
        "label": "Failure"
      },
      "start_node": {
        "edge_order": [
          "start_to_entry"
        ]
      },
      "success_conversation": {
        "conversation_config": {},
        "label": "Success A"
      },
      "success_end": {},
      "success_phone": {
        "transfer_destination": {
          "phone_number": "+1234567890"
        }
      },
      "success_transfer": {
        "agent_id": "success_transfer_agent"
      },
      "tool_node_a": {
        "edge_order": [
          "tool_a_to_failure",
          "tool_a_to_tool_b"
        ],
        "tools": [
          {
            "tool_id": "tool_a"
          },
          {
            "tool_id": "tool_b"
          }
        ]
      },
      "tool_node_b": {
        "edge_order": [
          "tool_b_to_conversation",
          "tool_b_to_end",
          "tool_b_to_phone",
          "tool_b_to_agent_transfer"
        ],
        "tools": [
          {
            "tool_id": "tool_a"
          }
        ]
      }
    }
  },
  "name": "My agent",
  "tags": [
    "Customer Support",
    "Technical Help",
    "Eleven"
  ],
  "version_description": "string",
  "procedures": {
    "property1": {
      "procedure_id": "string",
      "version_id": "string"
    },
    "property2": {
      "procedure_id": "string",
      "version_id": "string"
    }
  }
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|conversation_config|object \| null|false|none|Conversation configuration for an agent|
|platform_settings|object \| null|false|none|Platform settings for the agent are all settings that aren't related to the conversation orchestration and content.|
|workflow|[AgentWorkflowRequestModel](#schemaagentworkflowrequestmodel)|false|none|Workflow for the agent. This is used to define the flow of the conversation and how the agent interacts with tools.|
|name|string \| null|false|none|A name to make the agent easier to find|
|tags|[string] \| null|false|none|Tags to help classify and filter the agent|
|version_description|string \| null|false|none|Description for this version when publishing changes (only applicable for versioned agents)|
|procedures|object \| null|false|none|Procedure versions to publish, keyed by procedure_id. When provided, this map replaces the procedures from the current draft or branch tip. When omitted or null, unpublished procedure edits are used if present; otherwise, the branch tip's procedures are retained. Pass an empty object to remove all procedures.|

|text|string|true|none|The text that will get converted into a sound effect.|

|duration_seconds|number \| null|false|none|The duration of the sound which will be generated in seconds. Must be at least 0.5 and at most 30. If set to None we will guess the optimal duration using the prompt. Defaults to None.|
|prompt_influence|number \| null|false|none|A higher prompt influence makes your generation follow the prompt more closely while also making generations less variable. Must be a value between 0 and 1. Defaults to 0.3.|
|model_id|[SFXModelId](#schemasfxmodelid)|false|none|The model ID to use for the sound generation.|

<h2 id="tocS_Body_Speech_to_Text_v1_speech_to_text_post">Body_Speech_to_Text_v1_speech_to_text_post</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemabody_speech_to_text_v1_speech_to_text_post"></a>
<a id="schema_Body_Speech_to_Text_v1_speech_to_text_post"></a>
<a id="tocSbody_speech_to_text_v1_speech_to_text_post"></a>
<a id="tocsbody_speech_to_text_v1_speech_to_text_post"></a>

```json
{
  "model_id": "scribe_v2",
  "file": "string",
  "language_code": "string",
  "transcript_edit": "string",
  "tag_audio_events": true,
  "num_speakers": 1,
  "timestamps_granularity": "word",
  "diarize": false,
  "diarization_threshold": 0.1,
  "additional_formats": [
    {
      "include_speakers": true,
      "include_timestamps": true,
      "format": "segmented_json",
      "segment_on_silence_longer_than_s": 0,
      "max_segment_duration_s": 0,
      "max_segment_chars": 0
    }
  ],
  "file_format": "pcm_s16le_16",
  "cloud_storage_url": "https://storage.googleapis.com/my-bucket/folder/audio.mp3",
  "source_url": "https://storage.googleapis.com/my-bucket/folder/audio.mp3",
  "webhook": false,
  "webhook_id": "string",
  "temperature": 0,
  "seed": 12345,
  "use_multi_channel": false,
  "multichannel_output_style": "separate",
  "webhook_metadata": "{\"user_id\": \"123\", \"session_id\": \"abc-def-ghi\"}",
  "entity_detection": "string",
  "no_verbatim": false,
  "use_speaker_library": false,
  "detect_speaker_roles": false,
  "entity_redaction": "string",
  "entity_redaction_mode": "enumerated_entity_type",
  "keyterms": []
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|model_id|string|true|none|The ID of the model to use for transcription.|
|file|string(binary) \| null|false|none|The file to transcribe (100ms minimum audio length). All major audio and video formats are supported. Exactly one of the file or cloud_storage_url parameters must be provided. The file size must be less than 5.0GB.|
|language_code|string \| null|false|none|An ISO-639-1 or ISO-639-3 language_code corresponding to the language of the audio file. Can sometimes improve transcription performance if known beforehand. Defaults to null, in this case the language is predicted automatically.|
|transcript_edit|string \| null|false|none|Natural-language instruction applied to the final transcript (max 2000 characters). The edited text is returned in 'edited_transcript' alongside the original transcript. Cannot be combined with entity_detection, entity_redaction or use_multi_channel. Usage of this parameter will incur an additional 30% surcharge on the base transcription cost, billed for at least 10 seconds of audio.|
|tag_audio_events|boolean|false|none|Whether to tag audio events like (laughter), (footsteps), etc. in the transcription.|
|num_speakers|integer \| null|false|none|The maximum amount of speakers talking in the uploaded file. Can help with predicting who speaks when. The maximum amount of speakers that can be predicted is 32. Defaults to null, in this case the amount of speakers is set to the maximum value the model supports.|
|timestamps_granularity|string|false|none|The granularity of the timestamps in the transcription. 'word' provides word-level timestamps and 'character' provides character-level timestamps per word.|
|diarize|boolean|false|none|Whether to annotate which speaker is currently talking in the uploaded file.|
|diarization_threshold|number \| null|false|none|Diarization threshold to apply during speaker diarization. A higher value means there will be a lower chance of one speaker being diarized as two different speakers but also a higher chance of two different speakers being diarized as one speaker (less total speakers predicted). A low value means there will be a higher chance of one speaker being diarized as two different speakers but also a lower chance of two different speakers being diarized as one speaker (more total speakers predicted). Can only be set when diarize=True and num_speakers=None. Defaults to None, in which case we will choose a threshold based on the model_id (0.22 usually).|
|additional_formats|[AdditionalFormats](#schemaadditionalformats)|false|none|A list of additional formats to export the transcript to.|
|file_format|string|false|none|The format of input audio. Options are 'pcm_s16le_16' or 'other' For `pcm_s16le_16`, the input audio must be 16-bit PCM at a 16kHz sample rate, single channel (mono), and little-endian byte order. Latency will be lower than with passing an encoded waveform.|
|cloud_storage_url|string \| null|false|none|**Deprecated.** [Deprecated] This parameter is deprecated and will be removed in the future. Use 'source_url' instead.The HTTPS URL of the file to transcribe. Exactly one of the file or cloud_storage_url parameters must be provided. The file must be accessible via HTTPS and the file size must be less than 2GB. Any valid HTTPS URL is accepted, including URLs from cloud storage providers (AWS S3, Google Cloud Storage, Cloudflare R2, etc.), CDNs, or any other HTTPS source. URLs can be pre-signed or include authentication tokens in query parameters.|
|source_url|string \| null|false|none|The URL of an audio or video file to transcribe. Supports hosted video or audio files, YouTube video URLs, TikTok video URLs, and other video hosting services.|
|webhook|boolean|false|none|Whether to send the transcription result to configured speech-to-text webhooks.  If set the request will return early without the transcription, which will be delivered later via webhook.|
|webhook_id|string \| null|false|none|Optional specific webhook ID to send the transcription result to. Only valid when webhook is set to true. If not provided, transcription will be sent to all configured speech-to-text webhooks.|
|temperature|number \| null|false|none|Controls the randomness of the transcription output. Accepts values between 0.0 and 2.0, where higher values result in more diverse and less deterministic results. If omitted, we will use a temperature based on the model you selected which is usually 0.|
|seed|integer \| null|false|none|If specified, our system will make a best effort to sample deterministically, such that repeated requests with the same seed and parameters should return the same result. Determinism is not guaranteed. Must be an integer between 0 and 2147483647.|
|use_multi_channel|boolean|false|none|Whether the audio file contains multiple channels where each channel contains a single speaker. When enabled, each channel is transcribed independently. By default a separate transcript is returned per channel; set multichannel_output_style='combined' to instead receive a single transcript with all channels merged and sorted by time. Each word in the response includes a 'channel_index' field indicating which channel it was spoken on. A maximum of 5 channels is supported. Each channel is billed independently at the full audio duration, so cost scales linearly with the number of channels.|
|multichannel_output_style|string|false|none|Controls the response shape when use_multi_channel is enabled. 'separate' (default) returns one transcript per channel under 'transcripts'. 'combined' merges all channels into a single transcript whose words are sorted by start time, each carrying a 'channel_index' - matching the single-channel response shape. 'combined' requires timestamps (timestamps_granularity must not be 'none') and does not support entity detection or redaction.|
|webhook_metadata|string \| object \| null|false|none|Optional metadata to be included in the webhook response. This should be a JSON string representing an object with a maximum depth of 2 levels and maximum size of 16KB. Useful for tracking internal IDs, job references, or other contextual information.|
|entity_detection|string \| [string] \| null|false|none|Detect entities in the transcript. Can be 'all' to detect all entities, a single entity type or category string, or a list of entity types/categories. Categories include 'pii', 'phi', 'pci', 'other', 'offensive_language'. When enabled, detected entities will be returned in the 'entities' field with their text, type, and character positions.|
|no_verbatim|boolean|false|none|If true, the transcription will not have any filler words, false starts and non-speech sounds.|
|use_speaker_library|boolean|false|none|Whether to use the speaker library for identifying known speakers during diarization. When enabled and diarize is true, detected speakers will be matched against registered speakers in the workspace's speaker library.|
|detect_speaker_roles|boolean|false|none|Whether to detect speaker roles (agent vs customer). Requires diarize=true. Cannot be used with use_multi_channel=true. When enabled, speaker_id values will be 'agent' and 'customer' instead of 'speaker_0', 'speaker_1', etc. Usage incurs an additional 10% surcharge on base transcription cost.|
|entity_redaction|string \| [string] \| null|false|none|Redact entities from the transcript text. Accepts the same format as entity_detection: 'all', a category ('pii', 'phi'), or specific entity types. Must be a subset of entity_detection. When redaction is enabled, the entities field will not be returned.|
|entity_redaction_mode|string|false|none|How to format redacted entities. 'redacted' replaces with {REDACTED}, 'entity_type' replaces with {ENTITY_TYPE}, 'enumerated_entity_type' replaces with {ENTITY_TYPE_N} where N enumerates each occurrence. Only used when entity_redaction is set.|
|keyterms|[string]|false|none|A list of keyterms to bias the transcription towards.           The keyterms are words or phrases you want the model to recognise more accurately.           The number of keyterms cannot exceed 1000.           The length of each keyterm must be less than 50 characters.           Keyterms can contain at most 5 words (after normalisation).           For example ["hello", "world", "technical term"].           The following characters are not supported: `<`, `>`, `{`, `}`, `[`, `]`, `\`.           Usage of this parameter will incur an additional 20% surcharge on the base transcription cost.           When more than 100 keyterms are provided, a minimum billable duration of 20 seconds applies per request.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|timestamps_granularity|none|
|timestamps_granularity|word|
|timestamps_granularity|character|
|file_format|pcm_s16le_16|
|file_format|other|
|multichannel_output_style|separate|
|multichannel_output_style|combined|

|generation_mode|[MusicGenerationMode](#schemamusicgenerationmode) \| null|false|none|Optional generation mode hint for prompt-based music generation. Can only be used with `prompt`.|
|music_prompt|[MusicPrompt](#schemamusicprompt) \| null|false|none|**Deprecated.** A music prompt. Deprecated. Use `composition_plan` instead.|

|composition_plan|[MusicPrompt](#schemamusicprompt) \| [CompositionPlan](#schemacompositionplan) \| null|false|none|A detailed composition plan to guide music generation. Cannot be used in conjunction with `prompt`.|
|music_length_ms|integer \| null|false|none|The length of the song to generate in milliseconds. Used only in conjunction with `prompt`. Must be between 3000ms and 600000ms. Optional - if not provided, the model will choose a length based on the prompt.|
|model_id|[MusicModelID](#schemamusicmodelid)|false|none|The model to use for the generation.|
|seed|integer \| null|false|none|Random seed to initialize the music generation process. Providing the same seed with the same parameters can help achieve more consistent results, but exact reproducibility is not guaranteed and outputs may change across system updates. Cannot be used in conjunction with prompt.|
|force_instrumental|boolean|false|none|If true, guarantees that the generated song will be instrumental. If false, the song may or may not be instrumental depending on the `prompt`. Can only be used with `prompt`.|
|finetune_id|string \| null|false|none|The ID of the finetune to use for the generation|
|finetune_strength|number|false|none|How strongly the finetune influences the generation. Defaults to 1.0 (full strength). Lower values soften the influence of the finetune, leaving more room for prompt-level steering. Only meaningful when `finetune_id` is also provided.|

<h2 id="tocS_Body_Text_to_dialogue__multi_voice__streaming_v1_text_to_dialogue_stream_post">Body_Text_to_dialogue__multi_voice__streaming_v1_text_to_dialogue_stream_post</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemabody_text_to_dialogue__multi_voice__streaming_v1_text_to_dialogue_stream_post"></a>

<a id="tocSbody_text_to_dialogue__multi_voice__streaming_v1_text_to_dialogue_stream_post"></a>
<a id="tocsbody_text_to_dialogue__multi_voice__streaming_v1_text_to_dialogue_stream_post"></a>

```json
{
  "inputs": [
    {
      "text": "Hello, how are you?",
      "voice_id": "bYTqZQo3Jz7LQtmGTgwi"
    },
    {
      "text": "I'm doing well, thank you!",
      "voice_id": "6lCwbsX1yVjD49QmpkTR"
    }
  ],
  "model_id": "eleven_v3",
  "language_code": "en",
  "settings": {
    "stability": 0.5
  },
  "previous_text": "string",
  "future_text": "string",
  "pronunciation_dictionary_locators": [
    {
      "pronunciation_dictionary_id": "test",
      "version_id": "id2"
    }
  ],
  "seed": 12345,
  "apply_text_normalization": true,
  "use_pvc_as_ivc": true,
  "previous_request_ids": [
    "string"
  ],
  "next_request_ids": [
    "string"
  ],
  "audio_effects": {
    "filter_preset_id": "string",
    "distance": 0,
    "environment_id": "string",
    "background_noise_id": "string",
    "send_level": 1,
    "pan": 0
  }
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|inputs|[[DialogueInput](#schemadialogueinput)]|true|none|A list of dialogue inputs, each containing text and a voice ID which will be converted into speech. The maximum number of unique voice IDs is 10. For reliable generation, keep the total character count across all `inputs[].text` values at or below 2,000 characters per request. Longer requests can terminate early in streaming responses or return a validation error.|
|model_id|string|false|none|Identifier of the model that will be used, you can query them using GET /v1/models. The model needs to have support for text to speech, you can check this using the can_do_text_to_speech property.|
|language_code|string \| null|false|none|Language code (ISO 639-1) used to enforce a language for the model and text normalization. If the model does not support the provided language code, it will be ignored. This parameter is not supported for multilingual_v2 models.|
|settings|[ToDialogueSettingsResponseModel](#schematodialoguesettingsresponsemodel) \| null|false|none|Settings controlling the dialogue generation.|
|previous_text|string \| null|false|none|The text that comes immediately before this generation, used to condition the model for prosodic continuity. A maximum of 100 characters can be sent. Not supported by every model.|
|future_text|string \| null|false|none|The text that comes immediately after this generation, used to condition the model for prosodic continuity. A maximum of 100 characters can be sent. Not supported by every model.|
|pronunciation_dictionary_locators|[[PronunciationDictionaryVersionLocatorRequestModel](#schemapronunciationdictionaryversionlocatorrequestmodel)] \| null|false|none|A list of pronunciation dictionary locators (id, version_id) to be applied to the text. They will be applied in order. You may have up to 3 locators per request|
|seed|integer \| null|false|none|If specified, our system will make a best effort to sample deterministically, such that repeated requests with the same seed and parameters should return the same result. Determinism is not guaranteed. Must be integer between 0 and 4294967295.|
|apply_text_normalization|string|false|none|This parameter controls text normalization with three modes: 'auto', 'on', and 'off'. When set to 'auto', the system will automatically decide whether to apply text normalization (e.g., spelling out numbers). With 'on', text normalization will always be applied, while with 'off', it will be skipped.|
|use_pvc_as_ivc|boolean \| null|false|none|**Deprecated.** Whether to use the IVC version of a professional voice. This may improve expressiveness and reduce latency.|
|previous_request_ids|[string] \| null|false|none|A list of request_ids of dialogue generations that came before this one. Used to condition the model for continuity when splitting a large task into multiple requests. A maximum of 3 request_ids can be sent. The last request_id is the audio which is closest to the current request. Not supported by every model.|
|next_request_ids|[string] \| null|false|none|A list of request_ids of dialogue generations that come after this one. Useful for maintaining continuity when regenerating a clip in the middle of a sequence. A maximum of 3 request_ids can be sent. The first request_id is the audio which is closest to the current request. Not supported by every model.|
|audio_effects|[EffectsSpec-Input](#schemaeffectsspec-input) \| null|false|none|Audio effects applied to the generated audio. Unknown IDs return 404 with `param` naming the field. Reverb (`environment_id` with `send_level` above 0) and a non-zero `pan` produce stereo audio and are rejected with 400 for `ulaw_*`, `alaw_*`, and `pcm_*` output formats. Effects don't change the cost of the request.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|apply_text_normalization|auto|
|apply_text_normalization|on|
|apply_text_normalization|off|

```json
{
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|remove_background_noise|boolean|false|none|If set will remove background noise for voice samples using our audio isolation model. If the samples do not include background noise, it can make the quality worse.|
|selected_speaker_ids|[string] \| null|false|none|Speaker IDs to be used for PVC training. Make sure you send all the speaker IDs you want to use for PVC training in one request because the last request will override the previous ones.|
|trim_start_time|integer \| null|false|none|The start time of the audio to be used for PVC training. Time should be in milliseconds|
|trim_end_time|integer \| null|false|none|The end time of the audio to be used for PVC training. Time should be in milliseconds|
|file_name|string \| null|false|none|The name of the audio file to be used for PVC training.|

<h2 id="tocS_Body_Update_Studio_project_content_v1_studio_projects__project_id__content_post">Body_Update_Studio_project_content_v1_studio_projects__project_id__content_post</h2>

```json
{
  "from_url": "https://blog.elevenlabs.io/the_first_ai_that_can_laugh/",
  "from_document": "string",
  "from_content_json": "[{\"name\": \"Chapter A\", \"blocks\": [{\"sub_type\": \"p\", \"nodes\": [{\"voice_id\": \"6lCwbsX1yVjD49QmpkT0\", \"text\": \"A\", \"type\": \"tts_node\"}, {\"voice_id\": \"6lCwbsX1yVjD49QmpkT1\", \"text\": \"B\", \"type\": \"tts_node\"}]}, {\"sub_type\": \"h1\", \"nodes\": [{\"voice_id\": \"6lCwbsX1yVjD49QmpkT0\", \"text\": \"C\", \"type\": \"tts_node\"}, {\"voice_id\": \"6lCwbsX1yVjD49QmpkT1\", \"text\": \"D\", \"type\": \"tts_node\"}]}]}, {\"name\": \"Chapter B\", \"blocks\": [{\"sub_type\": \"p\", \"nodes\": [{\"voice_id\": \"6lCwbsX1yVjD49QmpkT0\", \"text\": \"E\", \"type\": \"tts_node\"}, {\"voice_id\": \"6lCwbsX1yVjD49QmpkT1\", \"text\": \"F\", \"type\": \"tts_node\"}]}, {\"sub_type\": \"h2\", \"nodes\": [{\"voice_id\": \"6lCwbsX1yVjD49QmpkT0\", \"text\": \"G\", \"type\": \"tts_node\"}, {\"voice_id\": \"6lCwbsX1yVjD49QmpkT1\", \"text\": \"H\", \"type\": \"tts_node\"}]}]}]",
  "auto_convert": false
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|from_url|string \| null|false|none|An optional URL from which we will extract content to initialize the Studio project. If this is set, 'from_url' and 'from_content' must be null. If neither 'from_url', 'from_document', 'from_content' are provided we will initialize the Studio project as blank.|
|from_document|string(binary) \| null|false|none|An optional .epub, .pdf, .txt or similar file can be provided. If provided, we will initialize the Studio project with its content. If this is set, 'from_url' and 'from_content' must be null. If neither 'from_url', 'from_document', 'from_content' are provided we will initialize the Studio project as blank.|
|from_content_json|string|false|none|<br>    An optional content to initialize the Studio project with. If this is set, 'from_url' and 'from_document' must be null. If neither 'from_url', 'from_document', 'from_content' are provided we will initialize the Studio project as blank.<br><br>    Example:<br>    [{"name": "Chapter A", "blocks": [{"sub_type": "p", "nodes": [{"voice_id": "6lCwbsX1yVjD49QmpkT0", "text": "A", "type": "tts_node"}, {"voice_id": "6lCwbsX1yVjD49QmpkT1", "text": "B", "type": "tts_node"}]}, {"sub_type": "h1", "nodes": [{"voice_id": "6lCwbsX1yVjD49QmpkT0", "text": "C", "type": "tts_node"}, {"voice_id": "6lCwbsX1yVjD49QmpkT1", "text": "D", "type": "tts_node"}]}]}, {"name": "Chapter B", "blocks": [{"sub_type": "p", "nodes": [{"voice_id": "6lCwbsX1yVjD49QmpkT0", "text": "E", "type": "tts_node"}, {"voice_id": "6lCwbsX1yVjD49QmpkT1", "text": "F", "type": "tts_node"}]}, {"sub_type": "h2", "nodes": [{"voice_id": "6lCwbsX1yVjD49QmpkT0", "text": "G", "type": "tts_node"}, {"voice_id": "6lCwbsX1yVjD49QmpkT1", "text": "H", "type": "tts_node"}]}]}]<br>    |
|auto_convert|boolean|false|none|Whether to auto convert the Studio project to audio or not.|

|isbn_number|string \| null|false|none|An optional ISBN number of the Studio project you want to create, this will be added as metadata to the mp3 file on Studio project or chapter download.|

<h2 id="tocS_Body_Update_document_v1_convai_knowledge_base__documentation_id__patch">Body_Update_document_v1_convai_knowledge_base__documentation_id__patch</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemabody_update_document_v1_convai_knowledge_base__documentation_id__patch"></a>
<a id="schema_Body_Update_document_v1_convai_knowledge_base__documentation_id__patch"></a>
<a id="tocSbody_update_document_v1_convai_knowledge_base__documentation_id__patch"></a>
<a id="tocsbody_update_document_v1_convai_knowledge_base__documentation_id__patch"></a>

```json
{
  "name": "string",
  "content": "string",
  "enable_auto_sync": true,
  "auto_remove": true,
  "minimum_frequency_days": 1,
  "tighten_only": false
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|string \| null|false|none|A custom, human-readable name for the document.|
|content|string \| null|false|none|Updated content for the document. Only supported for text documents, URL documents with auto-sync disabled, and file documents that are not synced from an external source.|
|enable_auto_sync|boolean \| null|false|none|Whether the document or folder is refreshed automatically. Only applicable to URL documents, folders, and externally-synced files. Leave unset to keep the current value.|
|auto_remove|boolean \| null|false|none|Whether to automatically remove the document once its source is no longer available. Only applicable when auto-sync is enabled. Leave unset to keep the current value.|
|minimum_frequency_days|integer \| null|false|none|Minimum frequency (in days) at which the document is refreshed. The actual interval may be shorter, never longer. Only applicable when auto-sync is enabled. Leave unset to keep the current value.|
|tighten_only|boolean|false|none|Folders only. When true, items already in the folder are only tightened to stay at least as strict as the folder, and keep any setting that is stricter than the folder's. When false, they are set to exactly the folder's auto-sync settings. Ignored for externally synced folders, whose contents always follow the folder's schedule.|

<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemabody_video_to_music_v1_music_video_to_music_post"></a>

<a id="tocsbody_video_to_music_v1_music_video_to_music_post"></a>

```json
{
  "videos": [
    "string"
  ],
  "description": "string",
  "tags": [],
  "model_id": "music_v1",
  "add_sfx": false,
  "separate_tracks": false,
  "use_audio_as_reference": false,
  "sign_with_c2pa": false
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|videos|[string(binary)]|true|none|<br>            One or more video files sent via FormData array (multipart/form-data). They will be combined into one codec in order.<br>            A maximum of 10 videos is allowed, where the total size of the combined video is limited to 200MB.<br>            In total, the video can be up to 600 seconds long. Note that combining multiple videos may increase the request duration significantly. If possible, combine the videos beforehand.<br>            |
|description|string \| null|false|none|Optional text description of the music you want. A maximum of 4100 characters is allowed.|
|tags|[string]|false|none|Optional list of style tags (e.g. ['upbeat', 'cinematic']). A maximum of 10 tags is allowed.|
|model_id|[MusicModelID](#schemamusicmodelid)|false|none|The model to use for the generation.|
|add_sfx|boolean|false|none|When true, incorporate SFX cues from the video.|
|separate_tracks|boolean|false|none|When true, return a ZIP with separate music and SFX audio tracks instead of a single mixed file. Use this for more flexibility to layer the tracks.|
|use_audio_as_reference|boolean|false|none|When true, analyze the video's audio track and use its genres, BPM, instrumentation, mood, and arc as reference characteristics for music generation.|
|sign_with_c2pa|boolean|false|none|Whether to sign the generated song with C2PA. Applicable only for mp3 files.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|model_id|music_v1|
|model_id|music_v2|
|model_id|music_v2_5|

<h2 id="tocS_Body_text_to_dialogue_full_with_timestamps">Body_text_to_dialogue_full_with_timestamps</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemabody_text_to_dialogue_full_with_timestamps"></a>
<a id="schema_Body_text_to_dialogue_full_with_timestamps"></a>
<a id="tocSbody_text_to_dialogue_full_with_timestamps"></a>
<a id="tocsbody_text_to_dialogue_full_with_timestamps"></a>

```json
{
  "inputs": [
    {
      "text": "Hello, how are you?",
      "voice_id": "bYTqZQo3Jz7LQtmGTgwi"
    },
    {
      "text": "I'm doing well, thank you!",
      "voice_id": "6lCwbsX1yVjD49QmpkTR"
    }
  ],
  "model_id": "eleven_v3",
  "language_code": "en",
  "settings": {
    "stability": 0.5
  },
  "pronunciation_dictionary_locators": [
    {
      "pronunciation_dictionary_id": "test",
      "version_id": "id2"
    }
  ],
  "seed": 12345,
  "apply_text_normalization": true,
  "use_pvc_as_ivc": true,
  "previous_request_ids": [
    "string"
  ],
  "next_request_ids": [
    "string"
  ],
  "previous_text": "string",
  "future_text": "string",
  "audio_effects": {
    "filter_preset_id": "string",
    "distance": 0,
    "environment_id": "string",
    "background_noise_id": "string",
    "send_level": 1,
    "pan": 0
  }
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|inputs|[[DialogueInput](#schemadialogueinput)]|true|none|A list of dialogue inputs, each containing text and a voice ID which will be converted into speech. The maximum number of unique voice IDs is 10. For reliable generation, keep the total character count across all `inputs[].text` values at or below 2,000 characters per request. Longer requests can terminate early in streaming responses or return a validation error.|
|model_id|string|false|none|Identifier of the model that will be used, you can query them using GET /v1/models. The model needs to have support for text to speech, you can check this using the can_do_text_to_speech property.|
|language_code|string \| null|false|none|Language code (ISO 639-1) used to enforce a language for the model and text normalization. If the model does not support the provided language code, it will be ignored. This parameter is not supported for multilingual_v2 models.|
|settings|[ToDialogueSettingsResponseModel](#schematodialoguesettingsresponsemodel) \| null|false|none|Settings controlling the dialogue generation.|
|pronunciation_dictionary_locators|[[PronunciationDictionaryVersionLocatorRequestModel](#schemapronunciationdictionaryversionlocatorrequestmodel)] \| null|false|none|A list of pronunciation dictionary locators (id, version_id) to be applied to the text. They will be applied in order. You may have up to 3 locators per request|
|seed|integer \| null|false|none|If specified, our system will make a best effort to sample deterministically, such that repeated requests with the same seed and parameters should return the same result. Determinism is not guaranteed. Must be integer between 0 and 4294967295.|
|apply_text_normalization|string|false|none|This parameter controls text normalization with three modes: 'auto', 'on', and 'off'. When set to 'auto', the system will automatically decide whether to apply text normalization (e.g., spelling out numbers). With 'on', text normalization will always be applied, while with 'off', it will be skipped.|
|use_pvc_as_ivc|boolean \| null|false|none|**Deprecated.** Whether to use the IVC version of a professional voice. This may improve expressiveness and reduce latency.|
|previous_request_ids|[string] \| null|false|none|A list of request_ids of dialogue generations that came before this one. Used to condition the model for continuity when splitting a large task into multiple requests. A maximum of 3 request_ids can be sent. The last request_id is the audio which is closest to the current request. Not supported by every model.|
|next_request_ids|[string] \| null|false|none|A list of request_ids of dialogue generations that come after this one. Useful for maintaining continuity when regenerating a clip in the middle of a sequence. A maximum of 3 request_ids can be sent. The first request_id is the audio which is closest to the current request. Not supported by every model.|
|previous_text|string \| null|false|none|The text that comes immediately before this generation, used to condition the model for prosodic continuity. A maximum of 100 characters can be sent. Not supported by every model.|
|future_text|string \| null|false|none|The text that comes immediately after this generation, used to condition the model for prosodic continuity. A maximum of 100 characters can be sent. Not supported by every model.|
|audio_effects|[EffectsSpec-Input](#schemaeffectsspec-input) \| null|false|none|Audio effects applied to the generated audio. Unknown IDs return 404 with `param` naming the field. Reverb (`environment_id` with `send_level` above 0) and a non-zero `pan` produce stereo audio and are rejected with 400 for `ulaw_*`, `alaw_*`, and `pcm_*` output formats. Effects don't change the cost of the request.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|apply_text_normalization|auto|
|apply_text_normalization|on|
|apply_text_normalization|off|

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

With 'on', text normalization will always be applied, while with 'off', it will be skipped.|
|use_pvc_as_ivc|boolean \| null|false|none|**Deprecated.** Whether to use the IVC version of a professional voice. This may improve expressiveness and reduce latency.|

|audio_effects|[EffectsSpec-Input](#schemaeffectsspec-input) \| null|false|none|Audio effects applied to the generated audio. Unknown IDs return 404 with `param` naming the field. Reverb (`environment_id` with `send_level` above 0) and a non-zero `pan` produce stereo audio and are rejected with 400 for `ulaw_*`, `alaw_*`, and `pcm_*` output formats. Effects don't change the cost of the request.|

|apply_text_normalization|on|
|apply_text_normalization|off|

```json
{
  "webhook": {
    "type": "all"
  },
  "model_id": "bytedance-seedance-v2.5",
  "prompt": "A corgi rides a tiny surfboard across a sunlit wave at golden hour, cinematic",
  "aspect_ratio": "16:9",
  "resolution": "720p",
  "duration_secs": 5,
  "generate_audio": true,
  "start_frame": {
    "type": "generation",
    "generation_id": "JWr5N6X9ZTqf8jD2LmQb"
  },
  "end_frame": {
    "type": "generation",
    "generation_id": "JWr5N6X9ZTqf8jD2LmQb"
  },
  "images": [
    {
      "type": "generation",
      "generation_id": "JWr5N6X9ZTqf8jD2LmQb"
    }
  ],
  "videos": [
    {
      "type": "generation",
      "generation_id": "JWr5N6X9ZTqf8jD2LmQb"
    }
  ],
  "audios": [
    {
      "type": "generation",
      "generation_id": "JWr5N6X9ZTqf8jD2LmQb"
    }
  ]
}
```

Request body for the ByteDance Seedance 2.5 video model.

Diverges from the Seedance 2.0 public shape: no 4K, durations up to 30s,
larger reference caps, audio-only input allowed, and no ``seed`` (Ark
tolerates it but does not honour it).

ByteDance models are disabled by default and require explicit approval
before use. Contact support to request access.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|webhook|[WebhookTarget](#schemawebhooktarget) \| null|false|none|Include to send the generation's result to the workspace's configured flows webhooks once it completes or fails. The webhook payload matches the terminal response of the corresponding GET endpoint.|
|model_id|string|true|none|The model to use for the generation.|
|prompt|string|true|none|A text description of the video to generate.|
|aspect_ratio|string|false|none|The aspect ratio of the output video. With `auto`, the model picks an aspect ratio based on the inputs. First-frame / first-and-last-frame tasks always use `auto`.|
|resolution|string|false|none|The resolution of the output video.|
|duration_secs|integer|false|none|The duration of the output video in seconds.|
|generate_audio|boolean|false|none|Whether to generate audio with the video.|
|start_frame|[ImageReference](#schemaimagereference) \| null|false|none|The image to use as the video's first frame.|
|end_frame|[ImageReference](#schemaimagereference) \| null|false|none|The image to use as the video's last frame.|
|images|[[ImageReference](#schemaimagereference)]|false|none|Up to 30 reference images to draw subjects from. Cannot be combined with `start_frame`/`end_frame`.|
|videos|[[VideoReference](#schemavideoreference)]|false|none|Up to 10 reference videos to draw subjects or motion from. Cannot be combined with `start_frame`/`end_frame`.|
|audios|[[AudioReference](#schemaaudioreference)]|false|none|Up to 10 reference audios, e.g. for lipsync. Cannot be combined with `start_frame`/`end_frame`.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|aspect_ratio|auto|
|aspect_ratio|21:9|
|aspect_ratio|16:9|
|aspect_ratio|4:3|
|aspect_ratio|1:1|
|aspect_ratio|3:4|
|aspect_ratio|9:16|
|resolution|480p|
|resolution|720p|
|resolution|1080p|

Request body for the ByteDance Seedance 2.0 video model.

ByteDance models are disabled by default and require explicit approval
before use. Contact support to request access.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|webhook|[WebhookTarget](#schemawebhooktarget) \| null|false|none|Include to send the generation's result to the workspace's configured flows webhooks once it completes or fails. The webhook payload matches the terminal response of the corresponding GET endpoint.|
|prompt|string|true|none|A text description of the video to generate.|
|aspect_ratio|string|false|none|The aspect ratio of the output video. With `auto`, the model picks an aspect ratio based on the inputs.|
|duration_secs|integer|false|none|The duration of the output video in seconds.|
|seed|integer \| null|false|none|A seed for reproducible generation: the same seed and inputs give similar output across generations. Omit for random.|
|generate_audio|boolean|false|none|Whether to generate audio with the video.|
|start_frame|[ImageReference](#schemaimagereference) \| null|false|none|The image to use as the video's first frame.|
|end_frame|[ImageReference](#schemaimagereference) \| null|false|none|The image to use as the video's last frame.|
|images|[[ImageReference](#schemaimagereference)]|false|none|Up to 9 reference images to draw subjects from. Cannot be combined with `start_frame`/`end_frame`.|
|videos|[[VideoReference](#schemavideoreference)]|false|none|Up to 3 reference videos to draw subjects or motion from. Cannot be combined with `start_frame`/`end_frame`.|
|audios|[[AudioReference](#schemaaudioreference)]|false|none|Up to 3 reference audios, e.g. for lipsync. Requires at least one of `images` or `videos`, and cannot be combined with `start_frame`/`end_frame`.|
|model_id|string|true|none|The model to use for the generation.|
|resolution|string|false|none|The resolution of the output video.|

```json
  "last_conversion_error": "Error message",

  "state": "converting",

      },

        "characters_unconverted": 400,
        "project_voice_ref_id": "voice456",
        "voice_id": "voice456"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|chapter_id|string|true|none|The ID of the chapter.|
|name|string|true|none|The name of the chapter.|
|last_conversion_date_unix|integer \| null|false|none|The last conversion date of the chapter.|
|conversion_progress|number \| null|false|none|The conversion progress of the chapter.|
|can_be_downloaded|boolean|true|none|Whether the chapter can be downloaded.|
|state|string|true|none|The state of the chapter.|
|has_video|boolean \| null|false|none|Whether the chapter has a video.|
|has_visual_content|boolean \| null|false|none|Whether the chapter has any visual content (video, image, or text clips).|
|voice_ids|[string] \| null|false|none|List of voice ids used by the chapter|
|statistics|[ChapterStatisticsResponseModel](#schemachapterstatisticsresponsemodel) \| null|false|none|The statistics of the chapter.|
|last_conversion_error|string \| null|false|none|The last conversion error of the chapter.|

|---|---|
|state|default|
|state|converting|

<h2 id="tocS_ClientToolConfig-Input">ClientToolConfig-Input</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaclienttoolconfig-input"></a>
<a id="schema_ClientToolConfig-Input"></a>
<a id="tocSclienttoolconfig-input"></a>
<a id="tocsclienttoolconfig-input"></a>

```json
{
  "expects_response": false,
  "type": "client"
}
```

A client tool is one that sends an event to the user's client to trigger something client side

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|type|string|false|none|The type of tool|
|name|string|true|none|none|
|description|string|true|none|Description of when the tool should be used and what it does.|
|response_timeout_secs|integer|false|none|The maximum time in seconds to wait for the tool call to complete. Must be between 1 and 120 seconds (inclusive), or -1 to wait for the client's response indefinitely (requires expects_response).|
|disable_interruptions|boolean|false|none|**Deprecated.** DEPRECATED: use `interruption_mode` instead. If true, the user will not be able to interrupt the agent while this tool is running.|
|interruption_mode|[ToolInterruptionMode](#schematoolinterruptionmode)|false|none|Controls whether the user can interrupt the agent around this tool call. 'allow' (default) lets the user interrupt at any time, 'disable_during_tool' suppresses interruptions only while the tool is running, 'disable_during_tool_and_turn' suppresses interruptions while the tool runs and for the agent response that follows it.|
|force_pre_tool_speech|boolean|false|none|**Deprecated.** DEPRECATED: use `pre_tool_speech` instead. If true, the agent will speak before the tool call.|
|pre_tool_speech|[PreToolSpeechMode](#schemapretoolspeechmode)|false|none|Controls whether the agent speaks before this tool is called. 'auto' (default) decides based on recent tool latency, 'force' always asks the agent to speak, 'off' fully opts out regardless of latency.|
|assignments|[[DynamicVariableAssignment](#schemadynamicvariableassignment)]|false|none|Configuration for extracting values from tool responses and assigning them to dynamic variables|
|tool_call_sound|[ToolCallSoundType](#schematoolcallsoundtype) \| null|false|none|Predefined tool call sound type to play during tool execution. If not specified, no tool call sound will be played.|
|tool_call_sound_behavior|[ToolCallSoundBehavior](#schematoolcallsoundbehavior)|false|none|Determines when the tool call sound should play. 'auto' only plays when there's pre-tool speech, 'always' plays for every tool call.|
|tool_error_handling_mode|[ToolErrorHandlingMode](#schematoolerrorhandlingmode)|false|none|Controls how tool errors are processed before being shared with the agent. 'auto' determines handling based on tool type (summarized for native integrations, hide for others), 'summarized' sends an LLM-generated summary, 'passthrough' sends the raw error, 'hide' does not share the error with the agent.|
|parameters|[ObjectJsonSchemaProperty-Input](#schemaobjectjsonschemaproperty-input) \| null|false|none|Schema for any parameters to pass to the client|
|expects_response|boolean|false|none|If true, calling this tool should block the conversation until the client responds with some response which is passed to the llm. If false then we will continue the conversation without waiting for the client to respond, this is useful to show content to a user but not block the conversation|
|dynamic_variables|[DynamicVariablesConfig](#schemadynamicvariablesconfig)|false|none|Configuration for dynamic variables|
|execution_mode|[ToolExecutionMode](#schematoolexecutionmode)|false|none|Determines when and how the tool executes: 'immediate' executes the tool right away when requested by the LLM, 'post_tool_speech' waits for the agent to finish speaking before executing, 'async' runs the tool in the background without blocking - best for long-running operations.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|interruption_mode|allow|
|interruption_mode|disable_during_tool|
|interruption_mode|disable_during_tool_and_turn|
|pre_tool_speech|auto|
|pre_tool_speech|force|
|pre_tool_speech|off|
|tool_call_sound_behavior|auto|
|tool_call_sound_behavior|always|
|tool_error_handling_mode|auto|
|tool_error_handling_mode|summarized|
|tool_error_handling_mode|passthrough|
|tool_error_handling_mode|hide|
|execution_mode|immediate|
|execution_mode|post_tool_speech|
|execution_mode|async|

|parameters|[ObjectJsonSchemaProperty-Output](#schemaobjectjsonschemaproperty-output) \| null|false|none|Schema for any parameters to pass to the client|
|expects_response|boolean|false|none|If true, calling this tool should block the conversation until the client responds with some response which is passed to the llm. If false then we will continue the conversation without waiting for the client to respond, this is useful to show content to a user but not block the conversation|
|dynamic_variables|[DynamicVariablesConfig](#schemadynamicvariablesconfig)|false|none|Configuration for dynamic variables|
|execution_mode|[ToolExecutionMode](#schematoolexecutionmode)|false|none|Determines when and how the tool executes: 'immediate' executes the tool right away when requested by the LLM, 'post_tool_speech' waits for the agent to finish speaking before executing, 'async' runs the tool in the background without blocking - best for long-running operations.|

|pre_tool_speech|off|
|tool_call_sound_behavior|auto|

|tool_error_handling_mode|passthrough|

Entity types for the API configuration.

This enum contains all valid entity type configurations that users can specify:
- Parent types (e.g., "name", "financial_id") that expand to all subtypes
- Specific subtypes using dot notation (e.g., "name.full_name")
- Standalone terminal types (e.g., "email_address")

When converted for service use, parent types expand to all their terminal subtypes.

<h2 id="tocS_ConversationConfigWorkflowOverride-Input">ConversationConfigWorkflowOverride-Input</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaconversationconfigworkflowoverride-input"></a>

<a id="tocsconversationconfigworkflowoverride-input"></a>

```json
{
  "client_events": [
    "audio",
    "interruption"
  ],
  "max_duration_seconds": 600
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|text_only|boolean \| null|false|none|If enabled audio will not be processed and only text will be used, use to avoid audio pricing.|
|max_duration_seconds|integer \| null|false|none|The maximum duration of a conversation in seconds|
|client_events|[[ClientEvent](#schemaclientevent)] \| null|false|none|The events that will be sent to the client|
|file_input|[FileInputConfigWorkflowOverride](#schemafileinputconfigworkflowoverride) \| null|false|none|Configuration for file input (image/PDF uploads) during conversations.|
|monitoring_enabled|boolean \| null|false|none|Enable real-time monitoring of conversations via WebSocket|
|monitoring_events|[[ClientEvent](#schemaclientevent)] \| null|false|none|The events that will be sent to monitoring connections.|
|dtmf_input_settings|[DTMFInputConfig](#schemadtmfinputconfig) \| null|false|none|Configure DTMF (keypad) input collection during phone calls|
|background_sound|[BackgroundSoundConfigWorkflowOverride](#schemabackgroundsoundconfigworkflowoverride) \| null|false|none|Configuration for background sound during conversations.|
|source_attribution|boolean \| null|false|none|When enabled and knowledge base content is present, the LLM is instructed to report which sources it used.|

```json
{
  "phone_number": "string",
  "label": "string",
  "supports_inbound": true,
  "supports_outbound": true,
  "provider": "twilio",
  "agent_id": "string",
  "sid": "string",
  "token": "string",
  "account_auth_token": "string",

    "region_id": "us1",
    "token": "string",
    "edge_location": "ashburn"
  },
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|phone_number|string|true|none|Phone number|
|label|string|true|none|Label for the phone number|
|supports_inbound|boolean|false|none|**Deprecated.** This field is deprecated and will be removed in the future. Whether this phone number supports inbound calls|
|supports_outbound|boolean|false|none|**Deprecated.** This field is deprecated and will be removed in the future. Whether this phone number supports outbound calls|
|provider|string|false|none|none|
|agent_id|string \| null|false|none|Agent ID to assign the phone number to|
|sid|string|true|none|Twilio Account SID (starts with `AC`) or API Key SID (starts with `SK`)|
|token|string|true|none|Secret paired with `sid`: the Account Auth Token for an Account SID, or the API Key Secret for an API Key SID|
|account_auth_token|string \| null|false|none|Twilio Account Auth Token, required for API Key imports to validate inbound webhook signatures|
|region_config|[RegionConfigRequest](#schemaregionconfigrequest) \| null|false|none|Twilio Additional Region Configuration|
|enable_sms|boolean|false|none|Route inbound SMS to ElevenLabs. On by default; set to false to skip SMS configuration for numbers that don't support it.|

<h2 id="tocS_CustomGuardrailConfig">CustomGuardrailConfig</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemacustomguardrailconfig"></a>
<a id="schema_CustomGuardrailConfig"></a>
<a id="tocScustomguardrailconfig"></a>
<a id="tocscustomguardrailconfig"></a>

```json
{
  "is_enabled": false,
  "name": "string",
  "prompt": "string",
  "execution_mode": "streaming",
  "model": "gemini-3.1-flash-lite",
  "history_message_count": 0,
  "history_include_tool_calls": false,
  "trigger_action": {
    "type": "end_call"
  },
  "evaluate_full_response_only": false
}
```

Single custom guardrail configuration

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|is_enabled|boolean|false|none|none|
|name|string|true|none|User-facing name for this guardrail|
|prompt|string|true|none|Instruction describing what to block, e.g. 'don't talk about politics'|
|execution_mode|[GuardrailExecutionMode](#schemaguardrailexecutionmode)|false|none|none|
|model|string|false|none|LLM model to use for custom guardrail evaluation|
|history_message_count|integer|false|none|How much recent history the guardrail sees before the reply it evaluates, counted in user messages (the agent replies between them are included too). The guardrail always gets a single <conversation_history> transcript ending in the evaluated reply, marked 'AGENT [current reply]:'. 0 (default) adds no prior history (just that line); 1 adds the latest user message onward.|
|history_include_tool_calls|boolean|false|none|When enabled, the history also renders the agent's tool calls, their input arguments, and the tool results, interleaved with the text, so an action between two agent messages is visible. Off by default: history shows only user and agent text. Tool payloads can be large and can mislead smaller evaluator models, so enabling this raises token cost.|
|trigger_action|[EndCallTriggerAction](#schemaendcalltriggeraction) \| [RetryTriggerAction](#schemaretrytriggeraction)|false|none|none|
|evaluate_full_response_only|boolean|false|none|Evaluate once against the complete non-TTS response instead of cumulative partials. Requires blocking mode.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|execution_mode|streaming|
|execution_mode|blocking|
|model|gemini-2.5-flash-lite|
|model|gemini-2.5-flash|
|model|gemini-3.1-flash-lite|
|model|gemini-3.5-flash|
|model|claude-haiku-4-5|
|model|claude-sonnet-4-6|
|model|gpt-5.4-nano|
|model|gpt-5.4-mini|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|additional_instructions|[StrippedStr](#schemastrippedstr)|false|none|Extra instructions for the agent (e.g., 'Always ask callers to spell out their name')|
|tone_traits|[[StrippedStr](#schemastrippedstr)]|false|none|Personality/tone trait keys that drive the Personality prompt section (e.g. ['professional', 'concise']).|
|details_to_collect|[[StrippedStr](#schemastrippedstr)]|false|none|Details the agent should always try to collect from callers (presets + custom labels, e.g. ['full name', 'phone number']).|
|llm|[LLM](#schemallm) \| null|false|none|Concrete LLM powering the receptionist. Constrained to SMB_ALLOWED_LLMS (see validate_reasoning_effort). None means no explicit model was chosen; the factory falls back to the historical default (SMB_DEFAULT_LEGACY_LLM) so configs predating this field keep their original model. New agents are created with SMB_DEFAULT_NEW_AGENT_LLM.|
|reasoning_effort|[LLMReasoningEffort](#schemallmreasoningeffort) \| null|false|none|Reasoning effort for the receptionist's model. Must be one of the model's supported efforts (see LLM.available_reasoning_efforts) and is capped at MEDIUM for SMB (see SMB_RECEPTIONIST_REASONING_EFFORTS); use null for the model default / models without configurable reasoning.|
|disable_rag|boolean|false|none|When true, the receptionist's knowledge base is injected in full into the system prompt instead of being retrieved via vector RAG on every turn. This removes the per-turn embedding + vector-search latency, but is only viable for small knowledge bases that fit within the prompt budget (KNOWLEDGE_BASE_IN_PROMPT_MAX_LEN). Knowledge bases too large to inline fall back to RAG at build time.|
|background_voice_detection|boolean|false|none|Filter out far-field human speech before transcription.|
|turn_eagerness|[SMBTurnEagerness](#schemasmbturneagerness)|false|none|How quickly the receptionist decides the caller has finished speaking. Eager replies soonest; patient waits for a clearer end of turn.|
|voice_id|string|false|none|ElevenLabs voice ID|
|language|[SupportedLang](#schemasupportedlang)|false|none|Primary language code|
|additional_languages|[[SupportedLang](#schemasupportedlang)]|false|none|Additional language codes the agent can communicate in|
|first_message|string|false|none|The first message the agent says when starting a conversation|
|disable_first_message_interruptions|boolean|false|none|When true, callers cannot interrupt the receptionist while the first message is being delivered. Use when the greeting carries a recording or legal notice callers must hear in full.|
|enable_end_call_tool|boolean|false|none|Allow the end_call system tool during conversations.|
|enable_skip_turn_tool|boolean|false|none|Allow the skip_turn system tool during conversations.|
|enable_play_keypad_touch_tone_tool|boolean|false|none|Allow the play_keypad_touch_tone (DTMF) system tool during conversations. When enabled, the receptionist can play touch-tone digits on a live call to navigate automated phone menus or answer carrier prompts such as a 'press 1 to accept' call-screening step.|
|agent_rules|[[AgentRule](#schemaagentrule)]|false|none|Behavioral rules this agent must follow.|
|transfer_rules|[[SMBTransferRule](#schemasmbtransferrule)]|false|none|Phone numbers this agent can transfer calls to.|
|hide_caller_number_on_transfers|boolean|false|none|Show the business's own number, rather than the caller's, as the caller ID on transferred calls.|
|record_after_transfers|boolean|false|none|Keep recording after a call is transferred and add that audio to the call recording.|
|procedures|[[SMBProcedure](#schemasmbprocedure)]|false|none|Standard operating procedures (SOPs) this agent can run on calls.|
|enable_secure_mode|boolean|false|none|When enabled, the receptionist may only look up or modify appointments and client records tied to the caller's verified phone number.|
|enable_spam_protection|boolean|false|none|When enabled, inbound calls to US numbers are screened before the receptionist answers: calls whose caller ID failed carrier (STIR/SHAKEN) verification are rejected, and unknown callers whose caller ID the carrier could not vouch for must press a key to be connected.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|turn_eagerness|patient|
|turn_eagerness|normal|
|turn_eagerness|eager|

```json
{
  "smb_tool_type": "delete_group_session"
}
```

Permanently remove a previously-cancelled group session.

Group analogue of ``delete_calendar_event``: cancel
(``cancel_group_session_for_all``) is the soft, history-preserving step;
this tool is the irreversible follow-up that drops the row from Mongo
and the staff Google Calendar entirely. The backend rejects the call
(422) if the session hasn't been cancelled yet, so the only safe path
is cancel-then-delete.

|---|---|---|---|---|

```json
{
```

```json
  "message": "string",
  "retryable": true
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|code|string|true|none|Stable identifier for the failure, safe to branch on. New codes are added over time, so we recommend treating an unrecognized value as `internal_error`.|
|message|string|true|none|Human-readable description of the failure, for display. The wording may change at any time, so we recommend branching on `code` instead.|
|retryable|boolean|true|none|Whether resubmitting the same input could succeed. A value of false means the failure describes the input or the account, so an identical retry will fail the same way.|

Signed, time-limited download URLs for a language target's outputs.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|lossless_audio|string \| null|false|none|Signed URL for the dubbed lossless audio track, in FLAC. The link expires one hour after it is issued; re-read the language target for a fresh one.|

<h2 id="tocS_DubbingLanguageResponse">DubbingLanguageResponse</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemadubbinglanguageresponse"></a>
<a id="schema_DubbingLanguageResponse"></a>
<a id="tocSdubbinglanguageresponse"></a>
<a id="tocsdubbinglanguageresponse"></a>

```json
{
  "language_id": "string",
  "project_id": "string",
  "target_language": "string",
  "status": "queued",
  "model_id": "string",
  "voice_settings": {
    "cloning_strength": 7
  },
  "outputs": {
    "lossless_audio": "string",
    "subtitles": "string"
  },
  "revision": 0,
  "output_revision": 0,
  "error": {
    "code": "string",
    "message": "string",
    "retryable": true
  },
  "warnings": [
    {
      "type": "voices_not_permitted",
      "speaker_ids": [
        "string"
      ],
      "message": "string"
    }
  ],
  "created_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "updated_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|language_id|string|true|none|Unique identifier of the language target.|
|project_id|string|true|none|Identifier of the parent dubbing project.|
|target_language|string|true|none|BCP-47 language tag this target is dubbed into.|
|status|string|true|none|Lifecycle status: `queued` (waiting on the project to be ready, or on a worker), `processing` while it is being dubbed, `completed` once its output is available, `stale` when the transcript changed after the output was produced, or `failed`.|
|model_id|string \| null|false|none|Dubbing model this target is dubbed with, inherited from the project and not selectable per language.|
|voice_settings|[VoiceSettings](#schemavoicesettings) \| null|false|none|Voice settings applied to every speaker in this language, or null if the defaults apply.|
|outputs|[DubbingLanguageOutputs](#schemadubbinglanguageoutputs) \| null|false|none|Signed output URLs; null until the target has produced an output (present once `completed`, and kept while `stale` — compare `output_revision` against `revision` to tell whether the output is up to date).|
|revision|integer|true|none|Monotonic counter incremented whenever this target's transcript changes (a source edit affecting it, or an edit to its translation).|
|output_revision|integer \| null|false|none|The `revision` the current dubbed output was generated from; equal to `revision` when up to date, and lower when `stale`. This is null until a generation has completed.|
|error|[DubbingError](#schemadubbingerror) \| null|false|none|Why this language failed; null unless `status` is `failed`, and also null for the few languages that failed before failure reporting was introduced. A code of `project_failed` means the parent project failed, so read the project for the underlying cause.|
|warnings|[[VoicesNotPermittedWarning](#schemavoicesnotpermittedwarning)]|false|none|Non-fatal conditions raised while dubbing this language, empty when there are none. Reflects the latest generation. Conditions raised while preparing the source are reported on the project instead.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|When the language target was created.|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|true|none|When the language target was last updated.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|status|queued|
|status|processing|
|status|completed|
|status|stale|
|status|failed|

<h2 id="tocS_DubbingProjectResponse">DubbingProjectResponse</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemadubbingprojectresponse"></a>
<a id="schema_DubbingProjectResponse"></a>
<a id="tocSdubbingprojectresponse"></a>
<a id="tocsdubbingprojectresponse"></a>

```json
{
  "project_id": "string",
  "status": "queued",
  "reference": "string",
  "source_language": "string",
  "model_id": "string",
  "media": {
    "filename": "string",
    "duration_s": 0,
    "has_video": true,
    "mime_type": "string"
  },
  "language_ids": [],
  "webhook_ids": [],
  "revision": 0,
  "error": {
    "code": "string",
    "message": "string",
    "retryable": true
  },
  "warnings": [
    {
      "type": "voices_not_permitted",
      "speaker_ids": [
        "string"
      ],
      "message": "string"
    }
  ],
  "created_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "updated_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|project_id|string|true|none|Unique identifier of the dubbing project.|
|status|string|true|none|Lifecycle status of the project: `queued` before the source is picked up, `preparing` while it is transcribed, `ready` once transcription is done and language targets can start, or `failed`. A project is never reported as `processing` — that value belongs to language targets.|
|reference|string \| null|false|none|The free-form string you supplied as `reference` when creating the project, or null if you supplied none.|
|source_language|string \| null|false|none|BCP-47 language tag of the source media (null if auto-detected).|
|model_id|string \| null|false|none|Dubbing model every language target of this project is dubbed with. Fixed at create time and not selectable per language.|
|media|[DubbingSourceMediaInfo](#schemadubbingsourcemediainfo) \| null|false|none|Source media metadata, populated once the source has been fetched and decoded (shortly after create, before the project is `ready`); null until then.|
|language_ids|[string]|false|none|Identifiers of the language targets under this project. Populated when a single project is fetched, and on create when `target_language` creates one. Always empty in list responses — list the project's language targets instead.|
|webhook_ids|[string]|false|none|IDs of the workspace webhooks notified as this project and its languages reach `ready`, `completed`, or `failed`.|
|revision|integer|true|none|Monotonic counter incremented whenever the source transcript is edited (segment add/edit/delete).|
|error|[DubbingError](#schemadubbingerror) \| null|false|none|Why the project failed; null unless `status` is `failed`. Also null for the few projects that failed before failure reporting was introduced.|
|warnings|[[VoicesNotPermittedWarning](#schemavoicesnotpermittedwarning)]|false|none|Non-fatal conditions raised while preparing the source, empty when there are none. Reflects the latest preparation. Conditions raised while dubbing a particular language are reported on that language instead.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|When the project was created.|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|true|none|When the project was last updated.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|status|queued|
|status|preparing|
|status|processing|
|status|ready|
|status|failed|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|regenerated_segment_ids|[string]|true|none|The segments this re-dub re-synthesizes: those with edits to apply.|

|charged_seconds|number|true|none|Seconds actually billed, after the free-regeneration allowance. Zero when the re-dub cost nothing — either the allowance covered all of it, or the project's included generation did.|
|free_regeneration_seconds_remaining|number|true|none|Free-regeneration seconds left for this language target after this re-dub. The allowance is the source's own duration.|

```json
  "source": "response",
  "value_path": "user.name"
}
```

Configuration for extracting values from tool responses and assigning them to dynamic variables.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|source|string|false|none|The source to extract the value from. Currently only 'response' is supported.|
|dynamic_variable|string|true|none|The name of the dynamic variable to assign the extracted value to|
|value_path|string|true|none|Dot notation path to extract the value from the source (e.g., 'user.name' or 'data.0.id')|
|sanitize|boolean|false|none|If true, this assignment's value will be removed from the tool response before sending to the LLM and transcript, but still processed for variable assignment.|
|preserve_native_type|boolean|false|none|If true, non-scalar values (lists, objects) extracted from the tool response are stored as their native type instead of being stringified to JSON. Enable this to use extracted arrays directly as list dynamic variables.|

<h2 id="tocS_EffectsSpec-Input">EffectsSpec-Input</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaeffectsspec-input"></a>
<a id="schema_EffectsSpec-Input"></a>
<a id="tocSeffectsspec-input"></a>
<a id="tocseffectsspec-input"></a>

```json
{
  "filter_preset_id": "string",
  "distance": 0,
  "environment_id": "string",
  "background_noise_id": "string",
  "send_level": 1,
  "pan": 0
}
```

Audio effects applied to generated speech: a filter preset, perceived distance, a reverb
environment, a background noise bed, and stereo panning. Leave every field at its default
to get unprocessed audio.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|filter_preset_id|string \| null|false|none|ID of a filter preset that colors the voice, such as `phone` or `old_radio`. List valid IDs with `GET /v1/audio-effects/catalog`.|
|distance|number|false|none|How far the speaker sounds from the microphone, from 0 (close, unchanged) to 1 (far). Higher values roll off low and high frequencies and, when an environment is set, shift the balance from the dry voice toward the reverb.|
|environment_id|string \| null|false|none|ID of a reverb environment that places the voice in a space, such as `small_room` or `hall`. List valid IDs with `GET /v1/audio-effects/catalog`. Reverb is rendered in stereo and adds a tail of up to several seconds after the speech ends.|
|background_noise_id|string \| null|false|none|ID of a background noise bed looped under the voice, such as `cafe` or `keyboard`. List valid IDs with `GET /v1/audio-effects/catalog`.|
|send_level|number|false|none|How much of the voice feeds the reverb, from 0 (none) to 1 (full). Only applies when `environment_id` is set; 0 turns the reverb off.|
|pan|number|false|none|Stereo position of the voice, from -1 (hard left) through 0 (center) to 1 (hard right). Only the voice is panned; reverb and background noise stay centered.|

```json
  },

    {
      "pronunciation_dictionary_id": "5xM3yVvZQKV0EfqQpLrJ",
      "version_id": "string"
    }
  ],

  }
```

Request body for the ElevenLabs Flash v2.5 TTS model.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|webhook|[WebhookTarget](#schemawebhooktarget) \| null|false|none|Include to send the generation's result to the workspace's configured flows webhooks once it completes or fails. The webhook payload matches the terminal response of the corresponding GET endpoint.|
|text|string|true|none|The text to synthesize into speech.|
|voice|string|true|none|The ID of the voice to speak with.|
|output_format|string|false|none|The audio encoding of the output, as `codec_sampleRateHz_bitrateKbps`. `mp3_44100_192` requires the Creator tier or above.|
|pronunciation_dictionary_locators|[[PronunciationDictionaryVersionLocator](#schemapronunciationdictionaryversionlocator)]|false|none|Pronunciation dictionaries to apply to the text, in order of precedence. Up to 3.|
